The figure is therefore job lines whose job resolves no client rate NOW, by the same function and tables; the card shows the job count with "N drafts blocked by missing rates", and a draft row shows "N jobs without a rate" with "Fix and review" as its action. Approval refuses those drafts (below).
- *Xero column*: a failed push is recorded distinctly. After the reservation is written, any failure sets `metadata.xeroExportState = "FAILED"` with `metadata.xeroExportFailure = { reason, at }` (provider message sanitised: one line, bearer tokens and long secrets redacted, at most 300 characters; `lib/billing/client-invoice-xero-failure.ts`) under the row lock; the reservation keeps the row locked against edits (`isXeroExportPending` covers PENDING and FAILED, also in DELETE, reconcile and the started-work review route) and Retry Xero reuses the same provider idempotency key; a successful retry sets EXPORTED and clears the failure. States everywhere (`lib/billing/client-invoice-xero-display.ts`: list cell, filter, editor card, stage bar): Not in Xero ("Not sent" on an unsent draft/approved row), Push pending (in flight or cut off), Push failed (reason and time), In Xero · not yet checked, Synced (last successful read agreed), Synced · paid in Xero, Needs review, State unknown. Filter values `failed` and `unchecked` added; needs-action includes failed.
- *Due* for DRAFT/APPROVED rows reads "On send · N-day terms" (the provisional day in the tooltip): the terms are fixed at first send. The admin PDF preview (and the PDF archive) of an unsent invoice prints "Due (provisional): … · N-day terms, fixed when sent"; the emailed PDF, the client portal PDF and documents never do. The due day itself is unchanged: created + terms in the organisation timezone.
- *Download PDFs* (bulk; `POST /api/admin/invoices/pdf-archive`, `lib/billing/client-invoice-pdf-archive.ts`, `lib/billing/zip-store.ts`): one ZIP of the selected invoices' PDFs rendered with the existing renderer, files named by number (`INV-0421.pdf`, duplicates suffixed), at most 50 invoices and 60 MB of PDF data (later rows listed as not included, never dropped). A row that cannot be rendered is listed in `_errors.txt` inside the archive and in the `X-Archive-Summary` response header, which the bulk bar shows. No zip dependency existed, so a STORE-only writer (CRC-32, central directory, UTF-8 names, no ZIP64) was added; a test opens it with `unzip -t`. The body is streamed from the rendered chunks.
- *Owing sortable*: computed in SQL, not stored (`lib/billing/client-invoice-owing-sql.ts`): `max(0, total − paidAmount − round2(Σ|total| of APPROVED/SENT credit notes))`, 0 on a credit note, mirroring `invoiceAmountOwing`/`creditedAmountOf` exactly; `paidAmount` is the cumulative column every payment path keeps and credits are rows, so SQL is reliable. Sorting takes the ids of the whole filtered set (refused above 20,000 with a "narrow the filters" message), orders them in one SQL `ORDER BY owing, id`, then reads the page. A database test compares the SQL figure with the TypeScript function over 40 fixtures and checks the list order. The CSV export uses the same ordering. The CSV writer moved to `lib/billing/client-invoice-csv.ts` (re-exported); its Xero state column reads FAILED for a failed push.

**Editor.**
- *Bill to, Period, Due on a DRAFT* (PATCH fields `clientId`, `period: { start, end }`, `paymentTermsDays`; `lib/billing/client-invoice-draft-fields.ts`, `editor-draft-fields.tsx`). Read only once approved or later (refused on the server). Bill to: a draft with job lines moves only when every job belongs to a property of the new client; a manual line grouped under a property, a shopping allocation or a started-work snapshot ties the draft to its client; both clients' billing locks are taken and the jobs re-checked against live invoices; a credit note's Bill to never changes. Period: two calendar days stored as Sydney day boundaries like the generator; never adds or removes lines; the response warns when job lines are scheduled outside it. Due: "Client terms (N days)" or an invoice-specific override stored in `paymentTermsDays` (0–365), which `termsSnapshotFor` already never overwrites at first send; shown as provisional until sent. Each change is a content edit (content locks apply) with a `CLIENT_INVOICE_DRAFT_FIELDS` History row (before values kept).
- *Add finished jobs (N not billed)* (`GET/POST /api/admin/invoices/[id]/jobs`, `lib/billing/client-invoice-add-jobs.ts`, `add-jobs-dialog.tsx`): N is the real count of the client's finished jobs on no live invoice. The picker shows each job's generator charge (or "No rate: set one first", not selectable) and marks jobs outside the period. Adding runs under the invoice row lock and the client's billing lock, re-reads every job, refuses the whole request when a job is no longer finished/unbilled/the client's or has no rate, checks holiday-rate snapshots like the generator, builds lines with the generator's own builder (extracted to `lib/billing/invoice-job-lines.ts`, used by both) and recomputes totals with the shared totals function; drafts only; not on a credit note or a started-work draft; carries the stale-write guard; History row `CLIENT_INVOICE_JOBS_ADDED`.
- *Send options* (send route fields `includePaymentLink`, `pushToXero`; defaults are today's behaviour). Attach PDF stays always on. Include payment link: offered only when the existing client payment-link route could work (Stripe on in Integrations and a Stripe key on the server; never on a credit note; `lib/billing/invoice-payment-link.ts`), otherwise disabled with the reason; the email gets a link to the client portal's invoices page, whose existing Pay now opens a checkout for what is owed (a checkout session is not emailed: it expires and the amount can change). Requested but unavailable → 409 and nothing is sent. Push to Xero when sent: after a successful send only, the existing idempotent push runs; a push failure never fails or rolls back the send, is returned beside the send (toast) and recorded as a History row and as the FAILED state above.
- *Autosave* (`use-invoice-editor.ts`). The PATCH accepts `expectedUpdatedAt`; on mismatch it writes nothing and answers 409 `{ code: "STALE_INVOICE", currentUpdatedAt }` (`lib/billing/client-invoice-stale-guard.ts`); callers that send none keep working (bulk, Xero sync, other screens). The editor sends the token on every write, autosaves typed line edits 1.5 s after the last keystroke, one save at a time, never while a line is invalid, and does not repeat a failed autosave until the drafts change or Retry is pressed. States: Saving… / Saved N seconds ago / Unsaved changes / Not saved / Not saved: changed elsewhere, with a conflict banner "Reload theirs" / "Keep my edits and retry" (re-reads the version, then sends the same absolute values). Approve, send and the other stored-invoice actions stay disabled until saved; the leave-page warning is on only while something is unsaved or saving. Typed text stays usable during a background autosave (what is typed then stays a draft); every other control waits.
- *Add-line box* (`add-line-row.tsx`, `use-line-suggestions.ts`): typing offers the client's unbilled finished jobs (picked → added through Add finished jobs) and saved items (picked → fills description and rate). Keyboard combobox; the list sits in the flow so the scrolling table never clips it.
- *Saved invoice items*: no existing catalogue fits (the price book is per job type and size; property rates are per property and job type), so a small list (name, default rate, GST flag) is stored in AppSetting `invoice-saved-items`, managed under Billing schedule → "Saved invoice items" (lazy disclosure), `GET/PUT /api/admin/invoices/saved-items` (stale saves refused, audited `INVOICE_SAVED_ITEMS_UPDATED`). The GST flag changes no arithmetic: GST is per invoice, so the editor shows a note when the item's flag differs from the invoice's GST switch, and the switch decides.
- *Xero card*: the sales account's name is read from Xero's chart of accounts when connected (`readXeroAccountName` in `lib/xero/client.ts`, cached 15 minutes, failures 2 minutes; `lib/billing/xero-account-name.ts`); when it cannot be read the card shows the code, "name unavailable" and the reason, never a guess. This needs the `accounting.settings.read` scope, now requested (opt out with `XERO_REQUEST_SETTINGS_READ=false`); it takes effect after the one Xero reconnect already required. The card says payments recorded in Xero come back automatically (hourly) and shows the last check time and state.
- *"Before you approve" enforced on the server* (owner-approved rule change; `lib/billing/client-invoice-approval-rules.ts`). A DRAFT is not approved, sent directly or marked paid while (a) a job line's job resolves no client rate now or a line amount is not a real number, (b) a job on it is on another live invoice (any client) or twice on it, (c) its stored total does not match its lines, or any of these cannot be checked; (d) started-work review was already enforced. Checked on the lines as they are after the request's own edits, under the client's billing advisory lock (the generator's). The refusal text is built from the checklist items, so the editor ("OK" / "Blocks approval" with the server's words and a link to fix: client rates page, the other invoice, the started-work panel), the PATCH, the send route and bulk approve state the same reason. Invoices already APPROVED or later are not affected: there the same checks read "Check" (advice). `invoiceTotalsMismatch` moved to `lib/billing/invoice-totals-check.ts` (re-exported from `client-invoices.ts`).

**History rows added:** `CLIENT_INVOICE_BATCH_CREATED`, `CLIENT_INVOICE_JOBS_ADDED`, `CLIENT_INVOICE_DRAFT_FIELDS`, `CLIENT_INVOICE_SEND_OPTIONS` (payment link included; push after send outcome).

**Not done / limits.** Nothing was run against real Xero, Stripe or email (mocked). The payment-link availability does not check whether the client's portal has the finance module switched on (a client without it would be refused by the portal). The batch run happens inside one request (200 clients at most); a crash mid-run leaves its key "still running" (open the dialog again for a new key; drafts already created are kept and reported by the generator's "already on a non-void invoice" wording). Sending a draft checks the approval rules in their own transaction just before the email, not in the same transaction as the sent stamp.

**Tests.** `tests/db/money-wave-d.test.ts` (PostgreSQL: owing parity and order, add jobs, Bill to rules, approval refuses double billing, batch idempotency and outcomes, failed push recorded/listed/retried with the same key), `tests/lib/money-wave-d.test.ts`, `tests/lib/money-wave-d-send.test.ts`, `tests/components/money-wave-d.test.tsx`; existing tests updated where they encoded the old behaviour (listed in the review record).

## Wave E without a database change: repair quote from a case, Chase supplier, document reminder, Tell client, Forms submissions, monthly once (2026-11-12)

Wave E ("Owner decision, sixth set") items that need **no schema change and no migration** (`docs/plans/admin-redesign-2026-11.md`). Everything new is stored in existing columns, QuoteEvent / LostFoundEvent / AuditLog rows or AppSetting receipts. Items that need a column (laundry pickup/drop clock times, charge from a case, cancel job, leave, effective-dated pay rates, required documents, "last seen", QA template snapshots, stock count to on-hand) stay for the schema step.

**Cases: Create repair quote, pre-filled (2026-11).** "Create repair quote" opens `/v2/admin/quotes/new?fromCase=<caseId>`. The page re-reads the case on the server (ADMIN, OPS_MANAGER as the quotes pages) through `loadCaseQuotePrefill` (`lib/cases/repair-quote.ts`): client (case client, else the property's / job's property's client), service address and suburb from that property, quote heading "Repair: <case title>", the description (case title, job number, case description) as the notes, and the case's image attachments (http(s) URLs only, at most 12) as reference images. A missing case shows a notice and an empty builder. Nothing is sent by pre-filling; the quote is a normal draft. `POST /api/admin/quotes` takes `fromCaseId`, re-checks the case exists, and in the quote's own transaction writes a `FROM_CASE` QuoteEvent `{ caseId, caseTitle, actorId }` and an internal case note "Repair quote Q-XXXXXX created from this case as a draft". The case's Next steps list "Quote Q-… created <time>" with links (`quotes` in `/api/admin/cases/[id]/linked`); the quote page shows "From case <title>" and its timeline "Created from case …". Quote reference images (create and PATCH) now pass the upload-ownership rule: the linked case's own attachments (office-visible case evidence) are allowed, any other new key must be the caller's or an office account's upload (existing problem fixed: the quote routes accepted any key).

**Laundry: Chase supplier (2026-11).** Offered on a run the Pipeline already flags OVER_TURNAROUND (picked up and at the laundry beyond the supplier's `avgTurnaround`, or beyond the maximum days out when none is recorded) that has a supplier (`lib/laundry/supplier-chase-rules.ts`), on the lane card (as drawn) and in the run panel. The dialog loads `GET /api/admin/laundry/[taskId]/supplier-chase`: the drafted message (property, bags, days with the supplier, usual turnaround), the supplier's stored email / phone, per transport whether it can be used and why not (no contact, invalid contact, email key missing, SMS switched off / not configured), the cool-down, and whether this account may send. Copy message, `mailto:` and `tel:` for everyone who can open the run (ADMIN, OPS_MANAGER); Send (email and/or SMS) for administrators only, never while impersonating, through `POST /api/admin/notifications/actions/supplier-chase` (`lib/laundry/supplier-chase.ts`). The send re-reads the run and re-applies the rule, sends only to the stored contact (the body cannot name an address; strict schema), one chase per run per 30 minutes (a retry of the same request passes; a failed send does not start the cool-down). Catalog `laundry.supplier_chase`.

**Shared external-recipient path (2026-11).** `lib/notifications/external-recipient.ts` now carries both messages to people without an account (`guest.message`, `laundry.supplier_chase`) with a per-kind policy: audit action and entity, per-record daily and per-sender hourly limits from the audit log plus the in-process limiter, one send per idempotency key (`dispatchNotificationOnce`), a delivery-log row with the provider's truthful state and an audit row with a masked address. `guest-message.ts` keeps its exports and behaviour on top of it.

**Command: Send reminder for an expiring document (2026-11).** The work-queue row offers "Send reminder" (primary) beside "Open account". The confirm (`document-reminder-dialog.tsx`) reads `GET /api/admin/workforce/document-reminder?documentId=` (person, which contacts exist, request title "Renewed <title>", wording, whether a reminder already went today) and sends with explicit transports (in-app notice with phone/browser push, email, SMS) through the workforce route's `REQUEST_DOCUMENT` with `documentId` (`lib/workforce/document-reminder.ts`): a renewal request due on the expiry date, one per document per organisation day (AppSetting receipt `documentReminder:<doc>:<day>`; a retry with the same key replays the recorded result, any other is refused with the first time), refused for an inactive account, a non-staff account, a document without expiry, or while impersonating; audited `STAFF_DOCUMENT_REMINDER_SENT`. Existing problem fixed in `REQUEST_DOCUMENT` itself: it wrote its notice as "SENT" and fired email and SMS without recording the providers' answers or escaping the title. It now delivers through `lib/workforce/document-request-send.ts`: notice and email on the office pipeline (STAFF_MEMBER scope, catalog `workforce.document_request`), SMS through the SMS chokepoint with its answer recorded (`workforce.document_request_sms`); the older Accounts "Request document" keeps its transports (notice, email when an address exists, SMS when a phone exists) and now returns real states. The row is shown only to viewers who may call the workforce route.

**Lost and found: Tell client sent from the app; Property sortable (2026-11).** New pipeline scope `LOST_ITEM_PROPERTY_CLIENT` (id = item; an active CLIENT login of the client that owns the item's property, re-checked when queued and at dispatch; fails closed when the reader cannot read items). `POST /api/admin/lost-found/[id]/send-client-notice` (ADMIN, not impersonating; `lib/lost-found/client-notice.ts`, catalog `lostfound.client_notice`): explicit transports, the client's "no notifications" switch refused, no active login refused, the timeline records "Client told (sent from the app)" with each transport's state, or "Message to the client not sent" with the reasons; a retry with the same key adds no second entry; audited. Operations managers keep copy-and-record (owner decision pending). Guest messages and the client notice keep Copy beside Send for every role. The app-sent guest message's timeline entry now says `sentByApp: true` (it said recorded by the office). The Property column and the sort menu sort by property name over the whole filtered set: the matching ids from the list's own where, then one raw query orders exactly those ids by `lower(name)` (no property last, then found date and id) with OFFSET/LIMIT; the CSV export uses the same order; refused above 20,000 matches. The Command work-queue lost-item row opens the item (`?stage=new&open=`).

**Forms: Submissions in Results and stats; classic page retired (2026-11).** Results and stats has two views (`view=` chips): Statistics and **Submissions** (the tab row stays as drawn). Submissions: `GET /api/admin/form-submissions?paginated=1` (`lib/forms/submission-list.ts`, `list-query`): sort by submitted, form, property, job, cleaner; filters search, form, submitted date (organisation days), with warnings; rows show form, property, job, cleaner, submitted, warning count, media count, laundry, and a PDF button; the old unpaged shape is kept. The submission view (side panel, `?submission=`; `GET /api/admin/form-submissions/[id]`, `lib/forms/submission-detail.ts`) shows the questions from the stored effective form (`__templateSchema`, else the live schema with a note), answers (Table as a real table, Stock count as "item · counted N unit"), warnings, laundry fields, media gallery, report preview (lazy) and edit history. Administrators edit answers and laundry fields and add / remove / restore media (`lib/forms/submission-edit.ts`). Existing problems fixed: edits overwrote answers with no history (now `FORM_SUBMISSION_EDITED` with before/after of each changed answer and laundry field); removing media deleted the stored file (now the link goes, the original stays, the full media row is a `FORM_SUBMISSION_MEDIA_REMOVED` tombstone and "Restore" puts it back, `FORM_SUBMISSION_MEDIA_RESTORED`); added media had no ownership check (now the caller's, a cleaner on the job's or an office account's upload only; a non-http URL is replaced by the key's public URL); internal `__` fields are refused; structured answers are read-only in the editor (the classic text box could turn them into "[object Object]"). The job pages keep using the same PATCH. `/admin/forms` redirects (ADMIN, OPS_MANAGER) with its tabs mapped: builder → Job forms, checklists → Checklist blocks / per-service, submissions → Results and stats / Submissions; `components/forms/checklists-workspace.tsx` is deleted (the v2 per-service checklists already did everything it did, plus photos). The job page's submission review also shows Table and Stock count answers this way.

**Classic cleaner job page (2026-11).** Not redirected: the classic look stays fully routable by design (`lib/portal-version.ts`), notification links still point at `/cleaner/jobs/<id>`, and the 6,766-line page could not be shown to be covered by the v2 page. Instead the classic field input renders Table and Stock count with the same shared controls as the v2 page (`components/v2/cleaner/structured-field-inputs.tsx`, now styled through a kit: Estate tokens for v2, classic tokens for the classic page), answering the same shapes.

**Monthly question once per month (2026-11).** `resolveEffectiveJobForm` also treats a monthly question as shown when another clean at the property this organisation month is submitted but not yet approved (job SUBMITTED or QA_REVIEW, not rework, not the job itself) and its stored effective form contained the question (`lib/accountability/monthly-pending.ts`, at most 25 submissions read). When that clean is reset or rejected it leaves those statuses and the question is due again; when it is approved, the existing stamp takes over.

**Design differences closed here.** Laundry: the three stat tiles moved to the top of Statistics and the Approvals line under the Pipeline, so the tabs sit under the header as drawn; lane cards carry their exception action (Ask cleaner, Request photo, Chase supplier) beside Move to. Cases: "Client can" is one choice (Not see it / See it / See and reply) as drawn, over the same two fields. Live ops: the late row's button reads "Tell client" as drawn (the confirm still says Notify client). Lost and found: Property sortable, sort menu entry.

**Tests.** `tests/api/case-repair-quote.test.ts`, `tests/api/laundry-supplier-chase.test.ts`, `tests/api/document-reminder.test.ts`, `tests/api/lost-found-client-notice.test.ts`, `tests/db/lost-found-property-sort.test.ts` (PostgreSQL parity across pages, both directions, filtered, export), `tests/api/form-submissions-office.test.ts`, `tests/components/structured-answer-display.test.tsx`, `tests/lib/monthly-pending-clean.test.ts`; updated on purpose: `tests/components/forms-authority-surface.test.tsx` (classic page now redirects), `tests/api/lost-found-office.test.ts` and `tests/components/lost-found-format.test.ts` (a client message is now sendable by an administrator), `tests/components/live-ops-follow-up.test.tsx` (row label), `tests/lib/case-linked-context.test.ts` and `tests/components/cases-refresh-and-qa.test.tsx` (linked quotes), `tests/lib/work-queue.test.ts` (lost item opens the item; Send reminder). No real message was sent (providers mocked).

## Wave E with the database: Applies-from pay rates, required documents, last seen, leave, Cancel job, end-time drops, QA template copies (2026-11-12)

Wave E items that need the schema (`docs/plans/admin-redesign-2026-11.md`, sixth set, and the eighth set's QA template copies). One forward migration, `20261112120000_wave_e_people_jobs`: enum value `JobStatus.CANCELLED`; `Job.cancelledAt / cancelledById / cancelReason / cancelledFromStatus`; `QaFormSubmission.templateSnapshot / templateSnapshotName / templateSnapshotSource / templateRevision`; tables `UserPayRate` and `StaffLeave`; CHECK constraints (rate 0–1000, leave end ≥ start, leave kind, a cancelled job has a reason). Backfills: one `UserPayRate` row per person with a rate (their current `hourlyRate`, effective 1970-01-01, source BACKFILL), so every past job resolves exactly as before; every existing inspection gets a template copy marked RECONSTRUCTED (the "before" schema of the first template revision recorded after it, else the template as it is now; revision = revisions recorded up to it); `User.lastSeenAt` raised to the latest recorded sign-in (passkey `WebAuthnCredential.lastUsedAt`, trusted-device creation) when later. Nothing else is written. Verified on a fresh database (twice, no pending changes, `migrate diff` empty), on the existing `sneek_ui` copy (row checksums of User, Job, QaFormSubmission, JobAssignment, ClientInvoice(+Line), Payout, PayrollRun, AuditLog unchanged apart from the new columns) and on a seeded database exercising each backfill.

**Effective-dated pay rate ("Applies from").** `UserPayRate` rows are never edited. THE resolver is `PayRateBook` (`lib/accounts/pay-rate-resolve.ts`): the rate on a job is the newest non-removed row with `effectiveFrom` ≤ the job's calendar day (`scheduledDate`, unshifted; a later save on the same day wins); someone with no rows falls back to `User.hourlyRate`; someone with rows but none in force that day has no default rate (null, never 0 — the calculators fall through to their next source). Every path that read `User.hourlyRate` for a job now reads the book: payroll (`lib/finance/payroll.ts`, jobs and QA inspections), cleaner invoices (`lib/cleaner/invoice.ts`, both job paths and QA), QA pay page (`lib/qa/pay.ts`), job pay summary, holiday rates, finance summary, Insights costs (`FactContext.rateBook`), branch scorecards (`lib/phase4/analytics.ts`), the cleaner briefing, the cleaner job form and home page, and the QA screens' rate previews. Order of precedence is unchanged (assignment snapshot → per-cleaner job-type rate → this default; QA: inspection rate → this default → settings). Snapshots and frozen amounts (assignment `payRate`, payouts, run totals, submitted cleaner invoices, settled QA/shopping pay) are never rewritten. `PATCH /api/admin/users/[id]/pay { hourlyRate, appliesFrom? }` (ADMIN only, as before) — Applies from defaults to today (Sydney) and is refused in the past or more than a year ahead; the first change for someone without rows writes the baseline row first; a future row on the same day is replaced (tombstoned); `User.hourlyRate` changes only for a rate from today. `GET` returns the history (ADMIN, OPS_MANAGER); `DELETE ?entryId=` removes a row that has not started (tombstone, audited `REMOVE_USER_PAY_RATE`); rows in force are refused. Bulk "Change rate" takes the same Applies from (source BULK). Screens that show "the rate" (Accounts list, person panel, cleaners roster, classic account page) show the rate in force today from the book. Not converted (display only, documented): the workforce performance pages still print the stored rate; the person summary's "estimated earnings" multiplies all logged hours by today's rate, as it did with the single rate.

**One Pay editor.** The rate is edited in one place: the person panel's Pay section on Profile (as drawn: Hourly rate + Applies from, "Jobs already paid keep the rate they were paid at."), the same component on the full account page. The Pay tab now shows the **Rate history** (in force / scheduled / past / removed, who saved it, Remove for a scheduled row) instead of a second editor. The classic account page links "Change pay rate" to the account page; per-job-type rates stay in Settings → Rates (linked from the history).

**Required documents per role.** AppSetting `staff_required_documents_v1 { byRole: { ROLE: [category…] } }` (`lib/accounts/required-documents*.ts`), Settings → Access → **Required documents** (catalog key `required-documents`, ops-catalog tab → accounts; office can view, ADMIN saves, audited `REQUIRED_DOCUMENTS_UPDATED`). Empty by default: nothing is shown as missing until a requirement is ticked; an unreadable stored value is reported, not treated as "nothing required". A person's requirements are the union over every role they hold. Documents section: each required type as On file / N d left / Expired / Missing (rejected documents do not count; the accounts list's 14-day window). Accounts list: a required type with nothing on file counts in "N missing" and in the Documents filter and Needs attention; the header adds "N missing documents"; "Complete" replaces "Up to date" only when requirements are set and all are on file.

**Last seen for everyone.** `recordLastSeen` (`lib/auth/last-seen.ts`) is called by the live session guards (`requireSession`, `requireRealSession`) with the genuine signed-in user id, resolved BEFORE the "test as" swap, so an impersonated target is never marked as seen. At most one write per person per 5 minutes per process, and the UPDATE matches only when the stored value is null or older than 5 minutes (several instances still write about once per interval); a failed write never refuses the request. Field-app pings keep writing it as before. Shown in the list (sortable, as before) and the person panel; null reads "Never signed in" for an invite not accepted, else "Not recorded yet".

**Leave and days off.** `StaffLeave` (calendar dates, end inclusive, kind LEAVE / DAY_OFF, note, created by; removal is a tombstone). `/api/admin/users/[id]/leave` GET/POST/DELETE for ADMIN and OPS_MANAGER (accounts pack at manage, as office notes); overlapping records refused; ended leave is history and not removed. Person panel → Work: "Leave and days off" list with Add/Remove (draft kept on cancel). Treated as unavailable: the Calendar's unavailability lane ("Leave" / "Day off" with the full reason as title and for screen readers, before "Not rostered"), cleaner suggestions (blocker kind `leave`, reason "On leave 12–14 Nov", before clashes and roster; peek button "On leave"), the move check (warning kind `leave`, shown in the confirmation), restore of a cancelled job, and the assign routes: `POST /api/admin/jobs/[id]/assign` and `/bulk-assign` answer 409 `LEAVE_CONFLICT` with each reason for a newly added cleaner on leave unless `confirmLeaveConflict: true` (the same confirm-and-resend pattern as `confirmCompletedReset`). The assign modal, quick assign and the Jobs bulk assign show the reason with "Assign anyway"; the calendar sends the override only after its confirmation listed the leave.

**Cancel job.** Rules (`lib/jobs/cancel-rules.ts`, service `lib/jobs/cancel.ts`, one transaction with the job row locked): a reason is always required; unstarted (Unassigned, Awaiting confirmation, Assigned): ADMIN or OPS_MANAGER (Jobs pack at manage); started (on the way through Completed): ADMIN only; never Invoiced or already Cancelled. Refused, with the reason, while the job is on an invoice that is not void (draft included), in a payroll run, paid through or on a cleaner invoice (not void / changes requested), has pay requests pending or approved, has settled QA pay or an inspection in progress, or a cleaner's clock is running. A cancel sets CANCELLED with who/when/why and the status it came from, releases the active assignments (rows, snapshots and responses kept), cancels QA inspections not started, keeps time logs, photos, forms, tasks and the laundry task (reported back for review), writes `JOB_CANCELLED` (incl. the admin behind a "test as"), and queues an inbox notice to the released cleaners (catalog `job.cancelled`, PIPELINE, STAFF_MEMBER scope, INBOX only: the phone/browser pushes are switched off explicitly; no email/SMS; client not told automatically). Restore (`/api/admin/jobs/[id]/restore`, ADMIN and OPS_MANAGER): only to the unstarted status it was cancelled from (a job that had started stays cancelled), with the released cleaners who are still active cleaners; the slot check (leave, clash, outside roster, day passed) answers 409 `RESTORE_CONFLICT` unless `confirmConflicts`, or `skipUserIds` leaves those cleaners off; inbox notice `job.cancel_restored`; audited `JOB_CANCEL_RESTORED`. Plain status edits can neither set nor leave CANCELLED (job PATCH, bulk status, Jobs status dialog); assign, auto-dispatch and reschedule refuse a cancelled job; the iCal sync never updates or revives one. UI: "Cancel job…" in the row menu (Restore… for a cancelled row), the peek panel (as drawn) and the bulk bar (`/api/admin/jobs/bulk-cancel`, one outcome per job); the job page's Danger tab; a cancelled job shows "Cancelled. Reason: …" with Restore. The existing delete is unchanged. Exclusions: the invoice generator (`NOT: { status: CANCELLED }`, even with time logged), Ready to bill, payroll, cleaner invoices, Insights/Quality (status inclusion lists), Live ops board, daily briefing, cleaner lists and apps (released assignment, plus explicit status lists), calendar (lanes, hours and counts; shown only with the Status filter "Cancelled", count still offered), the Jobs list default and the All / Today / This week counts (shown when the Status filter includes Cancelled), reminders (status inclusion lists), rework de-duplication, task carry-forward, public availability and booking capacity. The full audit of status enumerations is in the review record.

**Calendar day-view drop for a job with a separate end time.** `plannedTimeChange` moves start, due and end together (refused if the end would pass midnight or the job has an end but no start); the move check's plan carries `endTime`; `applyReschedule` writes it (audited before/after) and validates start ≤ end; Jobs bulk Reschedule passes it too. The confirmation shows "10:00–13:00 → 11:00–14:00 (the job keeps its length; start and end move together)".

**QA inspections keep a copy of their template.** A new inspection stores the template exactly as scored (`exactTemplateCopy`, revision = the template's QA_TEMPLATE_REVISION count, source EXACT); an amendment re-scores against the amended inspection's own copy and keeps it. Reading a past inspection (`inspectionTemplateSchema`) uses the copy; the QA report says "Template copy reconstructed: the exact version used is not known" for backfilled rows; the QA job API returns the copy and its label while amending, shown in the amending notice.

**Rules added (for the final summary).** A pay rate can never be backdated; it applies from today or a scheduled day, and a scheduled rate can be removed only before it starts. A job's default rate is the one in force on the job's day. Cancelling a job needs a reason; a started job needs ADMIN; money attached (non-void invoice, pay run, cleaner invoice, pay requests, settled QA pay) or a running clock refuses it; a cancel releases the cleaners and restore returns only to an unstarted status. Assigning a cleaner on recorded leave needs an explicit override. Leave is recorded by ADMIN and OPS_MANAGER with the accounts pack at manage. Required documents are set by ADMIN only.

**Tests.** `tests/db/wave-e.test.ts` (PostgreSQL: rates by day incl. future, payroll rates, snapshot untouched, no backdating, remove only future; cancel rules, refusals, release and restore; billing, Jobs list and calendar exclusion; leave in suggestions and conflicts; inspection copy after a template edit), `tests/lib/wave-e-rules.test.ts`, `tests/lib/wave-e-session.test.ts` (actual actor only, throttle, failure tolerated), `tests/lib/wave-e-cancel-notice.test.ts`, `tests/api/job-assignment-leave.test.ts`, new end-time cases in `tests/lib/calendar-time-drop.test.ts`. Updated on purpose: `tests/api/admin-user-pay.test.ts`, `tests/api/admin-users-bulk.test.ts` (history rows), `tests/api/calendar-check-move.test.ts` and `tests/lib/calendar-time-drop.test.ts` (end-time drops now allowed), `tests/lib/jobs-route-filters.test.ts`, `tests/lib/jobs-list-route-v2.test.ts`, `tests/lib/jobs-saved-view-counts.test.ts`, `tests/lib/jobs-view-presets.test.ts`, `tests/components/jobs-workspace-url.test.tsx` (twelve statuses, cancelled left out by default), `tests/lib/cleaner-briefing-audience.test.ts` (CANCELLED in the cleaner day exclusion); db mocks gained `userPayRate` / `staffLeave` / audit `count` in the finance, invoice, payroll, calendar, QA and assignment tests.

## Office sends for operations managers and the document request transport choice (2026-11-12)

Owner decisions of 2026-11-12 (items A and B in `docs/plans/admin-redesign-2026-11.md`, "Owner decisions, ninth set"). No schema change, no migration.

**A. Who may send the office messages that were administrator only.** One rule, `lib/notifications/office-send-rules.ts` (pure), checked on the server by `lib/notifications/office-send-permission.ts` on every send with the live session guard (`requireRole([ADMIN, OPS_MANAGER])`, which re-reads the account, its roles and the request path's pack) and the action's own pack read live with `getOpsAccess`:
- ADMIN: always (an administrator, or anyone holding ADMIN, never inherits a pack).
- OPS_MANAGER: only with the pack of the page the action lives on at "Manage available actions" (View only and Off are refused with 403 and the reason; another pack never stands in):

| Action | Pack | Send route (server check) | Where the button is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chase supplier | `laundry` | `POST /api/admin/notifications/actions/supplier-chase`; preview `GET /api/admin/laundry/[taskId]/supplier-chase` (`canSend`) | Laundry lane card and run panel |
| Message guest | `lost-found` | `POST /api/admin/lost-found/[id]/send-guest-message`, `POST /api/admin/notifications/actions/guest-message`; preview `GET /api/admin/lost-found/[id]/message` (`send.available`) | Lost and found item panel |
| Tell client (lost item) | `lost-found` | `POST /api/admin/lost-found/[id]/send-client-notice`; same preview | Lost and found item panel |
| Client delay notice | `jobs` | `POST` and preview `GET /api/admin/notifications/actions/client-delay` | Live ops late exception ("Tell client") |
| Clock pause | `jobs` | `POST /api/admin/jobs/[id]/pause-clock` | Live ops off-site exception |
| Message team (2026-11-13) | `jobs` | `GET`/`POST /api/admin/jobs/[id]/office-message` | Admin job page header primary action |

- Nobody while impersonating (administrators included): the send is refused with 403 and the preview says so; the target's restrictions apply. A revoked or deactivated account is refused by the session guard (401); a role other than ADMIN / OPS_MANAGER gets 403.
- Route ownership: the three notifications-area send routes now belong to the page's pack in `opsRequestFeature` (`supplier-chase` → laundry, `guest-message` → lost-found, `client-delay` → jobs), so the shared middleware and the session guard apply the same pack instead of `communications`. Staff message, laundry nudge and the rest of the notifications area stay with `communications`.
- Unchanged: rate limits, cool-downs, idempotency keys, recipient scopes, explicit transports, truthful states. Audit rows now record the actor's role beside the actor (`actorRole`: `ADMIN` or `OPS_MANAGER`) in `CLIENT_DELAY_NOTICE_SENT`, `ADMIN_CLOCK_PAUSE`, `LOST_FOUND_CLIENT_NOTICE_SENT`, `LAUNDRY_SUPPLIER_CHASE_SENT` and the guest message audit (addresses stay masked). The per-sender limits count the manager's own sends.
- UI: Send is shown where the server would allow it (Live ops gets `canNotifyClient` and `canPauseClock` from the same rule); Copy, mailto:, sms:, tel: and "record what you did" stay for everyone who can open the record. Live ops actions also still need the page not to be read-only (the Command viewer's existing `readOnly`).

**B. Request document asks which transport to use.** One choice component, `components/v2/admin/office-actions/transport-choice.tsx`, used by Accounts "Request document" (`components/v2/admin/accounts/document-request-dialog.tsx`, opened from the Compliance board and from a person's Documents section) and Command's "Send reminder" (`components/v2/admin/command/document-reminder-dialog.tsx`):
- Inbox (in-app notice with phone and browser push), Email and SMS are explicit, combinable choices; each is disabled with its reason (`lib/workforce/document-request-transports.ts`): account not active, no email address / phone number, switched off for `workforce.document_request` in Notifications, email key missing, SMS switched off or not configured. Options come from `GET /api/admin/workforce/document-request?userId=` (and the reminder preview, which now carries `options`).
- "Don't ask again" remembers the ticked transports for the signed-in office user only. Store: AppSetting `office_send_transports_v1:<userId>` (`{ version: 1, kinds: { document_request: { transports, savedAt } } }`, `lib/notifications/send-transport-preference.ts`, advisory-locked writes; the same pattern as the Jobs saved views). The next dialog uses it without asking but always shows "Sending by: Inbox, Email · Change · Ask me again", and names a saved transport this person cannot get with the reason. An unreadable row is reported and not used. Reset: "Ask me again" in the dialog, or Notifications → Preferences → "Your sending choices" (`GET` / `DELETE /api/me/send-transports`, the caller's own row only, not while impersonating).
- Server (`POST /api/admin/workforce` `REQUEST_DOCUMENT`, both paths): transports as named; when none are named, the sender's saved choice; otherwise **the inbox only**. Before this change a request that named none sent the inbox notice plus email when an address existed and SMS when a phone existed; automatic onboarding requests (workforce service) keep that old set because they do not come through the route. An explicit empty list, an unknown transport, or "remember" without transports is 400. Both paths are refused while impersonating (the plain request used to be allowed). `rememberTransports: true` saves the choice after the request succeeded. The answer adds `transportsUsed` and `transportSource` (`request` / `saved` / `default`). Recorded states as before (pipeline states for inbox and email, the SMS provider's own answer).

**Tests.** `tests/lib/office-send-rules.test.ts`, `tests/api/document-request-transports.test.ts`, `tests/components/document-request-dialog.test.tsx`; changed on purpose (ADMIN-only assertions replaced by pack rules, with OPS with pack → allowed, OPS without pack → 403, revoked / impersonated → restricted): `tests/api/admin-client-delay-notice.test.ts`, `tests/api/admin-clock-pause.test.ts`, `tests/api/laundry-supplier-chase.test.ts`, `tests/api/lost-found-client-notice.test.ts`, `tests/api/lost-found-office.test.ts`, `tests/api/notifications-area-routes.test.ts`, `tests/components/live-ops-follow-up.test.tsx`, `tests/components/lost-found-format.test.ts`; `tests/api/document-reminder.test.ts` (a request naming no transports is now inbox only). Providers mocked; no real message sent.

## Wave F: urgent stock shopping runs and buy asks, job on a need, operations managers, stock count observations, case charges, laundry clock times, New lost items (2026-11-12)

Wave F of the admin redesign (`docs/plans/admin-redesign-2026-11.md`, fifth / sixth / seventh sets and the database items carried from Wave B and Wave E). One forward migration, `20261112180000_wave_f_stock_cases_laundry`: `UrgentStockNeed.sourceJobId / sourceSubmissionId / shoppingRunId / shoppingRunAddedAt / shoppingRunAddedById` (FKs SetNull); new tables `UrgentStockPurchaseAsk` and `StockCountObservation`; `ClientInvoiceLine.caseId` (FK to `IssueTicket`, SetNull, indexed); `LaundryTask.pickupTime / dropoffTime` (`VARCHAR(5)`, `HH:mm` CHECK constraints); a backfill of the job on existing needs only where certain.

**Stock tabs as drawn.** Urgent needs, Levels by property, Shopping runs, Stock counts, Catalogue, then On-hand, Scan tasks and Suppliers (kept, the drawing does not show them). The `?tab=` ids are unchanged (`items`, `properties`, `on-hand`, `stock-counts`, `scan-tasks`, `shopping-runs`, `suppliers`, `urgent-stock`); the drawn names (`catalogue`, `levels`, `urgent`, …) map to them (`components/v2/admin/inventory/inventory-tabs.ts`). A bare URL opens Urgent needs for those who may see it, else Catalogue.

**Add to shopping run** (`lib/inventory/urgent-stock-shopping.ts`, `POST /api/inventory/urgent-stock/shopping-run`, GET lists open runs). Uses the existing shopping-run tables: the need's item and quantity become a PLANNED `ShoppingRunLine` on an open run (DRAFT or ACTIVE, not submitted, not settled) or on a new DRAFT run owned by the office user; an existing line for the same property and item is linked, not duplicated; the run's `updatedAt` is touched so an owner editing an older copy is refused by the run's stale-write guard. The need records `shoppingRunId` and an `ADDED_TO_SHOPPING_RUN` event; its stage does not change (adding is not ordering, buying or delivering). Quantity: the one entered, else the requested quantity, else par less the count; with none, the need is refused ("Enter how many to buy"). Idempotent per request id (receipt `urgent_stock_v1:run_receipt:*`) and per need ("Already on …"); a closed run is refused with the reason; a new run with nothing added is rolled back. Single (row "Next action" for an acknowledged need, as drawn; panel) and bulk ("Add to one shopping run"). The row and panel show the run and what the run says ("On run …", "Bought on run … not yet delivered" from the line's purchase, "line removed"); the need resolves only through its own stages and the property confirmation.

**Ask cleaner to buy** (`lib/inventory/urgent-stock-ask.ts`, `POST /api/inventory/urgent-stock/asks`, withdraw `POST /api/inventory/urgent-stock/asks/[id]`, cleaner `GET/POST /api/cleaner/urgent-stock/asks[/id]`). `UrgentStockPurchaseAsk` ASKED → ACCEPTED / DECLINED, or WITHDRAWN by the office; one live ask per need (`activeKey`). Default recipient: a cleaner on the next clean at the property (the same deadline rule as the list); any active cleaner may be chosen; a chosen job must be theirs at that property. Refused while shopping is turned off for cleaners, while the need is closed, already asked or on an open run. The notice is catalog type `urgent_stock.purchase_ask` (pipeline, scope `URGENT_STOCK_PURCHASE_ASK`: only the asked cleaner while the ask is ASKED, re-checked at dispatch), transports chosen by the office with the inbox alone as the default (`OfficeSendTransport` gained "INBOX": the inbox row without phone or browser push); the outcomes are stored on the ask. The cleaner answers on the v2 job screen (Clean stage, "Can you buy these?") and on Supplies → Shopping: Accept puts the need on their own open run (or a new DRAFT run they own) through the shared attach function; Decline takes an optional note. "Bought" is derived, never stored: run submitted, line purchased and `adminApprovedForCleanerReimbursement` (the existing office approval); submitted but unapproved reads "Bought · awaiting office approval".

**Job on a need.** A cleaner's report from the job screen sends `jobId` (checked: at the property and one of their active jobs; an office report may name a job at the property); a form submission's need stores the job and submission. Row: "Reported by Jane C. during job J-1038, today 11:05" with a link; panel: "Jane C. during J-1038". Backfill: the need's first REPORTED event note "… Submission <id>." where that submission exists, its job is at the need's property and its submitter is the need's reporter; every other need keeps null and reads "Reported by <name>".

**Operations managers** (`lib/inventory/urgent-stock-access.ts`). The urgent stock service, list, bulk, shopping-run and ask services accept OPS_MANAGER by the inventory feature of their pack: read to see (tab, nav badge, list, panel, open runs, candidates), manage for every write. ADMIN is unaffected. ~~Still ADMIN-only: Resolve (policy), bulk Close and the reminder settings.~~ Changed 2026-11-12 (owner decision): Resolve, bulk Close and the reminder settings need the pack at manage too; see "Owner decisions: urgent stock rights, need-opened notice, applied stock counts on reset". `/urgent-stock` redirects the office (with access) into Stock.

**Stock count observations** (`lib/inventory/stock-count-observations.ts`). At submission, inside the submit transaction, each Stock count answer becomes a `StockCountObservation` (unique per submission and item): PENDING, or NEEDS_REVIEW with the reason when the property does not stock the item or the item is inactive (the office gets an inbox notice, event `submission.stock_count_review`). Nothing changes while the clean waits for approval. `applyJobRotationCompletion` (called by every approval path) calls `applyApprovedStockCounts`: earlier submissions' pending counts become SUPERSEDED; each PENDING count of the latest submission is applied under the stock row lock (on-hand SET to the count, `ADJUSTED` ledger row linked to the submission, previous on-hand kept), unless a stock movement not written by that submission was recorded at or after the count (SKIPPED_NEWER, kept with the reason). Never applied twice. The urgent need raised from the same submission records the count as `PENDING_APPROVAL` instead of applying it at once (changed on purpose; the panel says "applied to stock when the clean is approved") and is settled to APPLY / STALE on approval. Changed 2026-11-12 (owner decision): an APPLIED count was left in place when the job was later reset; now every reset path asks the office to reverse or keep it (see "Owner decisions: urgent stock rights, need-opened notice, applied stock counts on reset"). Stock → Stock counts → "Counts from job forms" (lazy disclosure; `GET/POST /api/admin/inventory/stock-counts/form-observations`) lists them with state and reason; "Mark reviewed" (note required) closes a NEEDS_REVIEW count without touching on-hand.

**Cases: Add charge to invoice** (`lib/billing/client-invoice-case-charge.ts`, `GET/POST /api/admin/cases/[id]/invoice-charge`). Description, amount before GST (GST per the invoice's setting) and a DRAFT invoice of the case's client (the case's client, else its property's, else its job's) or a new blank draft (`createBlankInvoice`). The line is added by `patchClientInvoice` (row lock, content lock, stale guard, totals), whose `addLine` accepts `caseId` and refuses, under the lock, anything but a DRAFT invoice of the case's client (`client-invoice-case-charge-rules.ts`). `ClientInvoiceLine.caseId` (a column rather than metadata: an indexed join for "Charge on …", survives line edits, SetNull keeps a billed line if a case is deleted). The case shows "Charge on INV-… (draft)" with links and an internal case note; the editor line shows "From case …". Rights: exactly the invoice ones (ADMIN; OPS_MANAGER with finance at manage, checked here because the route is under Cases). Idempotent per request key (receipt `case_charge_v1:*`; a retry after a failure reuses the draft it created). Nothing is approved or sent.

**Laundry clock times** (`lib/laundry/planned-times.ts`, `PATCH /api/admin/laundry/[taskId]/times`, ADMIN and OPS_MANAGER as for editing a run). Planned pickup / drop time of day on the existing days, set in the run panel ("Set planned times", stale-write guard, audited `LAUNDRY_PLANNED_TIMES_UPDATED`); cards show "Driver Tom 14:30" / "Pickup 14:30" / "Drop 09:15" and the panel "Wed 11 Nov 15:00" only when a time was planned. Days, statuses and Calendar laundry counts unchanged.

**Lost and found: New items older than 14 days.** `NEW_ITEM_FLAG_DAYS = 14` (named, separate from the configurable holding period; organisation calendar days from the found date). Row badge "New · 16 d" (warning), chip "New over 14 days N" (`?flag=new-stale`), summary "· N still new after 14 days" when there are any, a panel note, and the Command work-queue row reads "Lost item still new after N days: …".

**Rules added (for the final summary).** Adding a need to a shopping run never changes its stage; a closed run (submitted, approved or later, or settled) takes no new lines. One live "buy" ask per need; only the asked cleaner can answer, only while asked; "Bought" requires the office's reimbursement approval. Operations managers act on urgent stock with the inventory pack at manage (read to see); ~~resolving stays ADMIN-only~~ since 2026-11-12 resolving, bulk Close and reminder settings also need manage (ADMIN unchanged). A form's stock count sets on-hand only on approval, only from the latest submission, never over a newer stock movement. A case charge goes only onto a DRAFT invoice of the case's client, by those who may edit invoices. An item still New 14 days after it was found is flagged.

**Tests.** `tests/db/wave-f.test.ts`, `tests/db/wave-f-case-charge.test.ts` (PostgreSQL), `tests/lib/wave-f-rules.test.ts`, `tests/components/wave-f-ui.test.tsx`, `tests/api/wave-f-routes.test.ts`, new cases in `tests/lib/notification-office-sends.test.ts` and `tests/lib/notification-entity-scope.test.ts`; fixtures updated on purpose in `tests/components/urgent-needs-table.test.tsx` (an acknowledged need now offers "Add to shopping run", as drawn), `tests/lib/admin-attention-urgent.test.ts` and `tests/api/urgent-stock-office.test.ts` (operations managers with the pack), `tests/api/cleaner-submit-form-effects.test.ts` and the rotation tests (approval and submission now touch count observations).

## Parity audit fixes: functions restored after the admin redesign (2026-11-12)

An audit compared the redesigned admin with the pre-redesign baseline (commit `1fb4077`) under the owner's rule that no function that existed before may be lost. No schema change, no migration.

**Finance: "Mark as sent (not emailed)".** The old editor could move a DRAFT or APPROVED invoice to SENT through its status control without emailing. `availableInvoiceActions` (`components/v2/admin/finance/invoices/invoice-model.ts`) offers `mark-sent` on DRAFT and APPROVED invoices (list row menu and editor "more" menu; it waits for unsaved edits like every action on the stored invoice). The confirm dialog (`mark-sent-dialog.tsx`) states that no email is sent and that terms, due date and the edit lock follow; a refusal stays in the dialog. It is `PATCH /api/admin/invoices/[id] { status: "SENT" }` through `patchClientInvoice`, so every rule of the status path still applies: the lifecycle graph, the leave-draft rules ("Before you approve": rates, double billing, totals), started-work review, empty-invoice and credit-note limits, the payment-terms and first-sent (`sentAt`) snapshot, and the content lock once SENT. The status path needs no PIN (only line removal and delete do). Same roles as other status changes (ADMIN; OPS_MANAGER with finance at manage). The PATCH never emails (the send route does), so a move to SENT through it now writes `CLIENT_INVOICE_MARKED_SENT` (`before.status`, `after: { status, emailed: false, note: "Marked sent without email", impersonatedBy }`) in the same transaction as the update; the History card reads "Marked sent without email".

**Finance: "Group by property" saves the order.** On an editable invoice, turning "Group by property" on saves the grouped line order through the existing reorder save (`reorderLineIds`, `propertyGroupedOrder` in `editor/line-sections.ts`: the PDF's own grouping, property sections alphabetically, extras last, order kept inside each), as the old `persistLineOrder` did. Nothing is saved when the order already reads that way; turning it off, or any toggle on a read-only invoice, only changes the view. The toggle waits while a save runs.

**Quality: Rating mix per cleaner.** `CleanerRow.ratingMix` (`lib/quality/cleans.ts` `ratingMixByCleaner`): the cleaner's reviewed cleans in the period by authoritative review, with the old overview's rule (management review flag counts as "Mgmt review" whatever the rating; otherwise EXCELLENT / PASS / NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT / FAILED / MANAGEMENT_REVIEW). A review with no recognised rating is counted as "No rating", never folded into a band. Shown in the cleaner's expanded row as pills (empty bands left out; "No reviewed cleans in this period." rather than zeros).

**Quality: Mgmt review queue.** `QualitySummary.managementReview.count`: reviewed cleans in the period (the hub's clean basis) whose authoritative review is flagged for management review or rated MANAGEMENT_REVIEW, each clean once. A sixth stat card "Mgmt review queue" links to `/v2/admin/approvals?queue=managementReviews`; the Approvals workspace now opens the queue named in `?queue=` (otherwise the first queue with work, as before; the queue buttons expose `aria-pressed`). The card's basis says the Approvals queue lists every flagged review still waiting, which is not limited to the period.

**Quality: review queue counters.** `GET /api/admin/quality/inspections` adds `counters: { awaiting, inProgress, completedToday, timeZone }` (`inspectionQueueCounters`, `lib/quality/inspections.ts`): OPEN or ASSIGNED; IN_PROGRESS; COMPLETED with `completedAt` since midnight in the organisation timezone (`settings.timezone`, fallback Australia/Sydney, daylight-saving safe), all narrowed by the same property and text filters as the list. The Review queue tab shows Awaiting QA, In progress and Completed today above the inspection queue; an answer without counters shows none, never zeros.

**Laundry team metrics for quality-pack viewers.** The ops catalog maps a path to one pack, so "either pack" is a second read route: `GET /api/admin/quality/laundry-team-metrics` (quality pack, live `requireRole([ADMIN, OPS_MANAGER])`, the same `getLaundryTeamMetrics` service and response as `/api/admin/laundry/team-metrics`, which keeps the laundry pack). The Quality hub has a lazy "Laundry team and suppliers" disclosure (`hub/laundry-team-section.tsx`: Our laundry team cards, unattributed stuck tasks, External suppliers; 7 / 30 / 90 days; nothing read until opened; period kept when collapsed; late answers for another period dropped). Its "Laundry statistics" link shows only when the laundry pack allows that page (`HubContext.laundryStatsLink`). QA inspectors do not get the section.

**Accounts KPI strip.** Total staff, Active cleaners and Total clients are back above the role tabs (`AccountsHub` `kpis`, from the page's existing `getAccountsOverview` call). `getAccountsOverview` now lists failed counts in `unavailable`; the page passes those as null and the strip shows "–" with a note, never a fallback 0. "Outstanding receivables" stays removed by owner decision (receivables live in Finance).

**`/urgent-stock`.** Already restored by Wave F: the page redirects an OPS_MANAGER with the inventory pack (server-checked by `urgentStockOfficeAllowed`) to `urgentStockOfficeHref`, keeping the property; ADMIN is redirected as before and cleaners keep their page. Covered by `tests/api/urgent-stock-office.test.ts`; no further change here.

**Dead notification links.** `lib/notifications/accountability.ts`: "Coaching record acknowledged" links to the Quality hub's Coaching tab (`QUALITY_COACHING_HREF`, `/v2/admin/quality?tab=coaching`); the recurring-pattern alert links to the Issues tab for that cleaner and category over its window when the hub has that period (`recurringPatternHref`, button "Open in Quality"). Old emails resolve: `app/admin/accountability/page.tsx` redirects to the hub's Cleaners tab keeping the query, and `app/admin/accountability/coaching/[id]/page.tsx` to the Coaching tab (neither path existed before; the ops catalog keeps gating `/admin/accountability` by the quality pack).

**Tests.** New: `tests/lib/invoice-mark-sent.test.ts`, `tests/db/invoice-mark-sent.test.ts` (PostgreSQL), `tests/api/quality-parity-audit.test.ts`, `tests/components/approvals-queue-deep-link.test.tsx`, `tests/lib/accounts-overview-kpis.test.ts`; new cases in `tests/components/invoice-editor-page.test.tsx`, `tests/components/invoice-row-actions.test.tsx`, `tests/lib/quality-hub-service.test.ts`, `tests/components/quality-hub-actions.test.tsx`, `tests/components/quality-hub-page-access.test.tsx`, `tests/components/accounts-hub.test.tsx`. Changed on purpose: the exact action lists in `tests/components/invoice-row-actions.test.tsx` and `tests/lib/client-invoice-editor-rules.test.ts` include `mark-sent`; summary and cleaner fixtures in `tests/components/quality-hub-actions.test.tsx` and `tests/components/quality-hub-bonus-actions.test.tsx` carry the new fields.

## Owner decisions: urgent stock rights, need-opened notice, applied stock counts on reset (2026-11-12)

Three owner decisions on Wave F, plus a fourth that needs no change. No Prisma schema change, no migration: `StockCountObservation.status` is free text and already kept `previousOnHand` and the applied ledger row (`stockTxId`), which is all a reversal needs.

**1. Operations managers: Resolve, bulk Close, reminder settings.** An OPS_MANAGER whose inventory pack is at "manage" may Resolve a need (`ADMIN_RESOLVED`), use bulk Close, and read and change the urgent-stock reminder settings. Enforced on the server: `actOnUrgentStock` computes `mayResolve` from `urgentStockOfficeAllowed(actor, "manage")` (role and extra roles re-read from the database, pack from the live policy) and passes it to `validateUrgentStockTransition` (the parameter was `isAdmin`); bulk Close runs each need through that same function; `setUrgentStockSettings` and the `settings` field of `listUrgentStock` use the same rule. The settings live only in this service (no settings-catalog screen has its own guard), so nothing else was widened. "read" is refused for all three. While an administrator impersonates a manager, the session user is the target, so the target's own pack applies (never the administrator's rights); `lib/inventory/urgent-stock-actor.ts` adds `impersonatedBy` for the audit. Audit: the reminder settings row (`URGENT_STOCK_REMINDERS_UPDATED`) records `before`, the new values, `actorRole` and `impersonatedBy`; a Resolve event's detail records `actorRole` and `impersonatedBy`. UI: Stock → Urgent needs gets `canResolve` / `canEditReminders` from the page (same server rule) instead of "role is ADMIN"; the panel's Resolve, the bulk bar's Close and the Reminder settings button follow them. Wording changed from "administrator" to "the office" where the action is no longer administrator-only ("Resolved by the office"). ADMIN unchanged.

**2. "Urgent need opened" notice for operations managers.** The notice (catalog type `stock.urgent_need`, event `urgent_stock.open_need`, inbox only, category `shopping`, personal preferences respected) now goes to every active ADMIN and every active OPS_MANAGER whose inventory pack is at least "read", through the intent pipeline with a new entity recipient scope `URGENT_STOCK_OFFICE` (id = the need) in `lib/notifications/recipient-scopes.ts`. The pack is checked when the notice is queued (`urgentNeedOpenedRecipients` in `lib/inventory/urgent-stock.ts`) and again at dispatch (inbox and provider paths call the same scope rule): a pack turned off in between skips the delivery (`recipient_not_in_scope`); a corrupt policy fails closed; a manager who also holds ADMIN has no pack restriction, as everywhere else. One notice per person: candidates are read once per account and the envelope role is the account's stored role (the old code addressed users with an extra ADMIN role as ADMIN, which the dispatcher then skipped). No email, SMS or device push was added. Reminders for unresolved needs are unchanged (administrators only, scope ADMIN_OPERATIONS); not decided.

**3. Applied stock counts when a job is reset.** `lib/inventory/stock-count-reset.ts`. Paths that take an approved job out of Completed, and what each now does:
- Reset job (`/api/admin/jobs/[id]/reset`, dialog `components/v2/admin/jobs/job-reset-dialog.tsx`), QA reset (`/api/admin/jobs/[id]/qa-reset`, classic job page `components/qa/admin-qa-reviews.tsx`), a status edit through `PATCH /api/admin/jobs/[id]`: when the job has APPLIED counts the request must carry `appliedStockCounts: "REVERSE" | "KEEP"`; otherwise 409 `STOCK_COUNT_CHOICE_REQUIRED` with `appliedStockCounts` (item, counted value, on hand now, value before the count) and a message naming them. Checked before the PIN and again inside the reset transaction (a count applied in between is caught). GET on the reset and QA reset routes lists the counts for the dialogs. The status edit's 409 also says to use Reset job (the job edit form shows the message; it has no choice control).
- Bulk status change: a COMPLETED job with applied counts going to any other status is a blocked row naming the reason ("Use Reset job …"); apply refuses the batch with 409 naming the jobs.
- QA verdicts that move a COMPLETED job back to QA_REVIEW (QA inspection fail, admin QA score fail, photo-review deduction fail, the authoritative-review recompute after a score is edited or deleted) are verdicts, not resets: the counts stay applied and each observation records "Kept: the job left approval … without an office choice" (audited `STOCK_COUNTS_KEPT_NO_CHOICE` when a person caused it; the recompute has no actor, so only the observation reason).
- The QA inspection Reopen (`/api/qa/jobs/[id]/reopen`) does not change the job's status and is unchanged.

Dialogs: the Reset job dialog and the QA reset dialog list the counts and ask "Reverse these counts" / "Keep them"; nothing is pre-selected and Reset stays disabled until one is chosen; a 409 that brings new counts shows them and clears the choice; the dialog's state resets when the job changes; the Reset job dialog's context read is cancelled when it closes or the job changes.

Reverse, per item, under the stock row lock: restore `previousOnHand` only when no stock movement was recorded at or after the count's own ledger row and on-hand still equals the counted value (a change without a ledger row also counts as newer); otherwise "not reversed: newer record" and left as it is; an unknown `previousOnHand` is "not reversed" (never taken as zero). A reversal writes an `ADJUSTED` `StockTx` (not linked to the submission, so it survives "Clear form data"), sets the observation to `REVERSED` with the reason and the reversal ledger id, and keeps the applied ledger row and `previousOnHand`. A REVERSED count is never applied again by a later approval. Keep leaves on-hand and status as they are and writes the decision on the observation. Every decision writes `STOCK_COUNTS_RESET_DECISION` (path, choice, outcomes, actor, role, impersonating administrator); the reset's own audit row carries the same outcomes. The response's `stockCounts` lets the dialogs say "N reversed; not reversed (newer record): …".

Reset job with "Clear form data": the choice runs first. The count's ledger row is detached from the submission (kept as the record that explains on-hand) instead of being "restored" and deleted with the submission's usage rows; usage rows of an item whose count stays in force (kept or not reversed) are not added back on top of the counted value; a reversed item returns to its pre-submission value as before. Limitation: the observation rows themselves still go with the deleted submission (`onDelete: Cascade`); their final state is in both audit rows.

Stock → Stock counts → Counts from job forms shows the new state "Reversed when the job was reset".

**4. Lost items still New.** Owner: an item still at New stays a separate count (the "New over 14 days" chip and summary are not merged into another count). No code change.

**Tests.** `tests/db/owner-decisions-stock.test.ts` (PostgreSQL, 13): manager with manage resolves and bulk-closes, read refused; settings by manage with audit role, read refused and sees none; impersonated read-only manager refused, impersonation recorded, a revoked pack takes effect at once; notice recipients (admins, managers with read / manage, not off, one notice for a manager who is also ADMIN); pack re-checked at dispatch and a muted preference skipped; reset requires the choice and names the counts; Reverse restores, newer movement not reversed, ledger kept, reversed count never re-applied; Keep; a path nobody decides; the reset, QA reset and job PATCH routes (409 then success, "Clear form data" with Keep). `tests/lib/stock-count-reset-rules.test.ts`, `tests/components/stock-count-reset-dialog.test.tsx`, `tests/components/qa-reset-stock-count-choice.test.tsx`, `tests/components/urgent-office-manage-controls.test.tsx`; new cases in `tests/lib/notification-entity-scope.test.ts` (scope rule) and `tests/lib/jobs-bulk-status.test.ts` (blocked row). Changed on purpose: `tests/db/wave-f.test.ts` (a manager with manage now resolves), `tests/lib/urgent-stock-policy.test.ts` and `tests/lib/urgent-stock-actions.test.ts` (`isAdmin` renamed `mayResolve`); fixtures given an empty `stockCountObservation` reader in `tests/api/qa-reset-financial-guard.test.ts` and `tests/lib/jobs-bulk-status.test.ts`.

## Owner reports: lost and found photos, laundry partners as suppliers, laundry team requests, account email resends (2026-11-12)

Owner's words: "Lost and found images doesn't show"; "Laundry partners is also suppliers, so need to link them and show them in suppliers list"; "Laundry pickup/drop off is handled by laundry partners/suppliers only so make the changes in the laundry page to ask laundry team buttons etc."; "Also allow re-send any invitations or emails related to new accounts, password resets, etc." One forward migration, `20261112210000_laundry_partner_links` (additive, nullable): `LaundrySupplier.stockSupplierId` (unique) and `User.laundrySupplierId` (FK to `LaundrySupplier`, `ON DELETE SET NULL`, indexed).

**Lost and found photos (root cause and fix).** Photos are stored as `{ key, url }` with `url = S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL/<key>` (`publicUrl`), and the pre-redesign board (`1fb4077`) rendered that link directly. Everything else in the app treats the bucket as private and signs on demand, so the public link only works where the bucket is public and `S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` is set. The redesign's fallback asked `/api/uploads/access`, which refuses every cleaner (job-scoped `jobs/<jobId>/` keys only; lost-found keys are `lost-found/<uploader>/…`) and every role but ADMIN/OPS_MANAGER/QA; the cleaner detail gallery had no fallback at all; the office "Log item" preview used the same public link. Now every place a lost item photo appears (table thumbnail, item panel and its lightbox, the cleaner's item detail, the Log item preview) shows it through `GET /api/lost-found/[id]/photo?key=<key>` (`lib/lost-found/photo-src.ts`): same access rule as opening the item (ADMIN, OPS_MANAGER, or the reporting CLEANER while the module is on), the key must be one of the item's own photos, answer is a 302 to a 10-minute signed link (`private, no-store`); if storage cannot sign it falls back to the public link only when `S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` is set, else 503 `STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`. Serialized items carry `photos[].src` (the stored `url` is unchanged). A photo that cannot be loaded shows "Image could not be loaded" with Retry (asks the route again), never a blank; the lightbox says so too. The Log item preview uses a local object URL. Clients have no lost-found screen and the "Tell client" message carries no photo. The classic cleaner page lists no photos. Production checks: see the review record.

**Laundry partners in the Suppliers list.** Inventory › Suppliers reads `GET /api/admin/inventory/suppliers/directory` (`lib/laundry/partners.ts`, read model `lib/suppliers/directory-types.ts`): stock suppliers (AppSetting catalog, unchanged) and laundry partners (`LaundrySupplier`) together, type "Stock supplier", "Laundry partner" or both when linked. A partner row shows its contact, turnaround (hours, "not recorded" when empty), price per kg, its laundry portal team ("No laundry portal users linked" when none) and "Laundry runs (n)" → `/v2/admin/laundry?supplier=<id>` (the Pipeline opens filtered to that partner). "Add laundry partner" and "Edit partner" use the existing laundry supplier endpoints, which now also take `stockSupplierId` ("Same business as": one stock supplier links to one partner, 409 otherwise; 404 when the stock record is gone) and `teamUserIds` (LAUNDRY accounts only; moving someone from another partner is allowed and recorded); both are optional, so Laundry › Suppliers keeps working unchanged. Changes are audited `LAUNDRY_PARTNER_LINKS_UPDATED`. Deleting a stock supplier unlinks the partner (the partner, its runs and team stay); deleting a partner unlinks its people (accounts stay). A link to a stock supplier that no longer exists is reported on the list, never dropped silently.

**Laundry pickup and drop-off go to the laundry partner's team.** `lib/laundry/nudge-rules.ts`: the cleaner is asked only about the bags at the property ("Ask cleaner": NOT_READY, or bags unconfirmed on the pickup day after the clean); the cleaner photo request and the cleaner ask for an overdue pickup the cleaner marked ready are no longer offered. Team requests, each only where the run calls for it: "Ask laundry team to confirm pickup" (pickup due/overdue, bags not reported not-ready), "Ask laundry team to confirm drop-off" (picked up, drop day reached), "Ask laundry team: when will it be back?" (over turnaround or drop overdue), "Ask laundry team for a photo" (delivered without the required drop photo). They go through `POST /api/admin/notifications/actions/laundry-team-request` (ADMIN and OPS_MANAGER, as the cleaner nudge; never while impersonating) → `sendLaundryTeamRequest` (`lib/notifications/office-actions.ts`), catalog `laundry.team_request`, new recipient scope `LAUNDRY_TASK_SUPPLIER_TEAM` (active LAUNDRY account whose `laundrySupplierId` is the run's supplier and who may see the property under the laundry visibility rule; checked when queued and again at dispatch), 30-minute cool-down per run and kind (audit `LAUNDRY_TEAM_REQUEST_SENT`), the server re-applies the Pipeline rule, transports chosen explicitly, truthful per-recipient states. A run whose partner has no such users shows the button disabled with the reason, and "Chase supplier" is then offered for the stored contact even before the turnaround is exceeded, with a draft that asks for the same thing (`supplier-chase-rules.ts` `unansweredTeamRequest`, decided again on the server). Lane cards show the most pressing team request and the cleaner ask; the run panel shows all, the partner as "Laundry partner" and its "Laundry team" names. The route stop label "Driver Tom, stop 2" became "<partner> · Tom, stop 2" ("Laundry team · …" without a partner), and the Pipeline filters read "Laundry team" and "Laundry partner". The laundry portal Today page has "Requests from the office" (`lib/laundry/office-requests.ts`): requests addressed to the signed-in team member in the last 72 hours for runs they can see, "Open" while the run still calls for it, else "Done", with "Answer on the Queue" (existing confirm pickup / drop-off / photo actions); a read failure says so.

**Account emails.** Inventory and rules in `lib/accounts/account-email-rules.ts`. Resendable: the invitation link (UserInvitation), a password reset link (30 minutes, to the person's own account address only) and the sign-up code (self-registered, unverified). Each send issues a fresh token or code that replaces the previous one, has a 5-minute cool-down per person and type (a provider-refused send can be retried at once), goes through the existing mail path (`sendEmailDetailed`, critical/transactional as before) and is audited `ACCOUNT_EMAIL_SENT` with the real sender, role, address and the provider's answer (`lib/accounts/account-email-record.ts`): Accepted (delivery not confirmed), Not sent, Unknown, Not sent (not configured/switched off). Not resendable by design: temporary-password emails (use the reset link instead; a password is never mailed or shown again), sign-in and two-step codes, VA invitations and document requests (their own screens resend). Senders: ADMIN, or OPS_MANAGER with Staff accounts at manage (office-send-rules `account_email`); never while impersonating; never to a person whose role (primary or extra) is above the sender's; not to yourself. The person panel's Activity tab (and the full page) has "Account emails" (`GET/POST /api/admin/users/[id]/account-emails`): the account address, invitation state, the buttons the viewer may use (or why not), confirm before sending, the provider's answer after, "Copy invitation link" for a pending, unexpired invitation (`POST …/invitation-link`, not re-issued, audited `ACCOUNT_INVITATION_LINK_COPIED`), and the history from `ACCOUNT_EMAIL_SENT` plus older records (account created with invitation, administrator temporary password, client portal access, invitation accepted), "Not recorded" where nothing was recorded. "Forgot password" now records its sends and is limited to 3 per address per 15 minutes (it had no limit), and its email escapes the person's name.

**Fixed on the way.** "Resend invite" (person menu, `POST /api/admin/users/[id]/resend-otp`, Accounts bulk) sent a sign-up CODE to people the office invited by LINK, who have no password, so it could not get them in; it now sends a fresh invitation link to a pending invitation and the code only to a self-registered login, with the sender rules, cool-down and audit above (an OPS_MANAGER could previously resend to an administrator, without the pack check). The bulk action is "Resend invitation" and the menu item is shown only for an active person with a pending invitation or unverified email.
