- **Not built (reported):** maintenance invoices (proposed; maintenance has no pay in the portal); inspector reordering of their own visit order (needs a permission decision: the endpoint is office-only); a single "Fail" verdict; Know before you go summary line on Today (the queue does not carry it); inspection pay on the sign-off header; review scores on the Pay Reviews tab; offer-back progress (Waiting / In progress) in the Rework list; the passkey offer on the invitation screen itself (accepting does not create a session; offered in onboarding instead); two-step method switch (the server chooses the method); "Remember this device" on the first sign-in screen (it only applies to the two-step step); "Do this later from Profile" in onboarding (onboarding completion is required); "Link checked" on password reset (the link is checked on submit); the public quote wizard (shared `RequestQuotePage`, unchanged); "Cleaning in your suburb" in the menu (no index page); "Saved on this phone" offline wording for maintenance (nothing is queued); approved cost "limit" enforcement.

## Client portal redesign: five tabs, Home and dashboard, property tabs, Approvals with quotes, Money, Messages (2026-11-12)

Approved boards "Client portal" (`ClientPortal.dc.html`, phone) and "Client portal desktop" (`ClientPortalDesktop.dc.html`). Presentation and composition: no schema change, no migration, no change to payment, approval, dispute or quote decision logic. Two read-only additions to existing client routes and services are listed under "Data".

- **Navigation.** Phone tabs Home, Cleans, Approvals, Money, More (`components/v2/client/portal/portal-nav.ts`, plain module; `lib/navigation/mobile-tabs.ts`). Messages (envelope with the unread count) and the Request sheet ("+") sit in the header on every screen through the new backward-compatible `PortalShell` prop `headerActions`; the phone menu button is hidden (More replaces the drawer, and carries switch role, classic look and sign out). `/v2/client/more` is the grouped More menu again (Your cleans · Your homes · Support, billing, account; paired rows "Shopping · Stock counts", "Referrals · Assistants", "Profile · Settings"), filtered on the server. Desktop rail grouped as drawn (Overview; Your cleans; Your homes; Support; Billing; Account). "Book a clean" and "Request a quote" left the rail: they are in the Request sheet (Book, Rebook, Extra task or add-on, Request a quote, Something needs fixing, Raise an issue or dispute, Start a shopping run or stock count — each a link into the existing flow) and the dashboard header. Laundry and Reports left the tab bar; they are in More, on each property and on each clean, URLs unchanged. The Approvals badge counts extras plus quotes waiting.
- **Gates.** Every menu uses one rule: an assistant is offered only destinations their grants open (fail closed while grants load; money decisions, quotes, shopping, stock counts, referrals, assistants, profile and settings are never offered to an assistant), and nobody is offered a module switched off for this client. Module switches come from `isClientModuleEnabled` over the merged per-client visibility (`lib/client/portal-modules.ts`). Pages keep their own guards.
- **Old URLs.** `/v2/client/money`, `/services` and `/disputes` redirect keeping the query string (`lib/navigation/redirect-query.ts`). `/v2/client/more` is a menu again. Every other URL is unchanged.
- **Home (phone) and dashboard (desktop).** One page, one load (`lib/client/home-dashboard.ts`), two compositions. Phone: date, "Welcome back", Happening now (a clean on the way, on site or paused today; cleaner names only with the names switch), "N approvals waiting" with Review approvals, Upcoming cleans (Confirmed / Awaiting cleaner), Last report (Open report, PDF with the downloads switch), Needs you (the existing attention items) and a sticky Book a clean. Desktop: greeting with account, date, properties, clean in progress and decisions waiting; Request and Book a clean; KPI cards (Happening now, Waiting for you, To pay, Low stock); "Your properties" table with sortable columns (Next clean, Last report, Stock, Laundry, Preferred cleaner, Open items); month calendar of cleans and laundry (calendar switch); right column with Invoices (To pay, View invoice, Download PDF, the single Pay now, two previous invoices, not yet invoiced), Waiting for your decision (Decline / Approve on extras through the same versioned respond route; quotes open My quotes) and the latest office message with Reply. Each section shows a failed read as unavailable and lists it in the retry alert; nothing becomes zero. The pinned property portfolio (pins, cards / compact) moved to Properties.
- **Property page.** Tabs Overview, Reports, Photos, Stock, Laundry, Care (`?tab=`), with the existing cards: Overview has Next clean, Preferred cleaner, one summary card per topic, upcoming services, activity and the checklist preview (collapsed); Care keeps the lazy property care disclosure. Reports, Stock and Laundry tabs appear only with their switches (Reports also needs the assistant's reports grant); an unknown or hidden `?tab` opens Overview. "Book a clean here" opens booking (the booking flow takes no property pre-selection).
- **Approvals.** Waiting N | History (`?view=history`). Extras: badge, amount, context, note, Decline, Offer other price (reveals the counter amount), Approve $amount; countered requests show what was proposed. Quotes waiting for a decision (SENT) are listed with Decline / Ask for change / Accept as links to `/v2/client/quotes?quote=…&intent=…`, where My quotes scrolls to the quote and focuses that action (or opens the change request) — nothing is decided until the client presses it there; an expired quote offers no Accept. Quotes are read on the server without marking them viewed. Same respond/counter routes, version check, locks and draft retention (`components/v2/client/approvals/use-client-approvals.ts`). Account holder only, as before.
- **Money.** To pay (sum still owed, due day, the invoice to pay first), Invoices | Unbilled | Rates (`?tab=`), work not yet invoiced on Invoices, and one Pay $amount now for the first payable invoice in "pay first" order (overdue, then earliest due). Owing, due day and states come from the existing receivables and terms rules (`lib/billing/client-portal-money.ts`): Due, Overdue, Not yet sent (provisional due day), Part paid, Paid (recorded payment only; fully credited and credit notes are labelled as such), unknown terms say "Due date unavailable". Payable is unchanged (SENT or APPROVED, client only). `?paid=1` says the payment was handed to the provider and Paid appears once confirmed.
- **One clean.** Header "Property · today" with the charged amount when invoice lines exist and may be shown; "Cleaner has arrived · checked in on site" while on site (the time only where live progress is shared); Manage this clean in the drawn order (Ask for ETA, Ask for an update, Request an add-on, New date, Request the report, Skip this clean) and "Message us about this clean". Same requests and confirmations.
- **Messages.** "sNeek team" thread with receipts: a message reads "Saved HH:mm" only after the server returns the receipt for the same request id; otherwise it stays "Not confirmed" with "Retry the same message", which resends the same request id (no second copy). Draft and pending receipt are kept per account context in session storage; reads are serial and abortable.
- **Settings.** Event rows as drawn ("Cleaner on the way", "Clean started", "Clean finished, report ready") showing the channel; toggles freeze while a save is in flight; "Profile, billing and security · passkey" row.
- **Data.** New fields reaching the client, each behind the check of the page that already shows the same data: `/api/client/attention-counts` adds `counts["/v2/client/messages"]` (unread office messages in the Messages page's scope; messages grant) and `portal.modules` (booleans from the merged visibility); the finance overview adds per-invoice owing, due day, paid day and line counts (finance switch and invoice grant; the client PDF prints the same due day and lines); Home reads pending approval titles/amounts and SENT quotes (account holder with approvals on; same rows as Approvals and My quotes), the latest office message (messages grant, job scope), preferred cleaner names (properties switch and grant, as on the property page) and cases awaiting the client per property (cases switch and maintenance grant).
- **Fixed by default.** A scoped assistant could open any of the client's cleans by URL on the clean page (now `propertyScopeWhere`); an assistant without the invoice grant saw the clean's invoice lines (now hidden); the calendar page showed cleaner names with the names switch off; approval, property and laundry history times were printed in server time (now Sydney); the old Home listed the oldest laundry tasks.

## Suppliers directory, laundry partner pipeline actions and the laundry partner portal (2026-11-12)

Owner: "build all designs as drawn" for the boards "Suppliers" (directory and the Laundry pipeline actions in its lower half) and "Laundry partner portal". Owner decisions applied: a laundry login belongs to exactly one laundry partner; trades (maintenance workers) appear as suppliers; suppliers are edited in one directory (Inventory › Suppliers, URL kept; People links to it); the laundry team answers office requests in the portal. One forward migration, `20261112230000_laundry_team_request_replies` (one new table, nothing existing changed).

**Suppliers directory** (`/v2/admin/inventory?tab=suppliers`, `components/v2/admin/inventory/suppliers/*`, read model `lib/suppliers/directory-view.ts`). The Suppliers tab now has its own header (h1 "Suppliers", Export, "Add supplier ▾": Laundry partner, Stock supplier, Trade in Maintenance) above the Stock tabs, as Urgent needs does. Tabs All / Laundry partners / Stock suppliers / Trades and maintenance / Inactive with real counts (type tabs count active records; `?type=` keeps the tab), search, "Needs attention" (runs over turnaround, a partner without portal logins, no contact), "Has portal logins", Category; sortable columns Supplier, Type, Terms, Portal logins, In progress, On time; "–" where nothing is measured. `GET /api/admin/inventory/suppliers/directory` (unchanged route and roles) now also returns `trades` (optional; People's read-only list ignores it) and, per partner, `stats` and login extras (`lib/suppliers/directory-load.ts`): to pick up / at the laundry / to drop by Sydney day, late = picked up longer than the agreed turnaround, on time = share of runs delivered in the last 30 days within the turnaround (null without a turnaround or runs), actual average hours, properties with runs in the last 60 days, chase history (`LAUNDRY_SUPPLIER_CHASE_SENT`, 90 days), and each login's last seen and pending invitation. Figures that fail to load are left out and shown as not available; the records still load. Trades are a read model over `MaintenanceWorker` (company else name, trade, contact, MAINTENANCE login, assigned items not resolved or dismissed); they are edited in Maintenance. Side panel (`?open=<key>`): a laundry partner has Overview (contact, turnaround agreed and actual, price, properties, chase-by from the stored contact, same-business stock record), Logins (last seen / Invited, Remove, "Link an existing laundry login", "+ Invite" to People), Schedule (no schedule fields exist: says so), Runs (figures, Pipeline link, chase history) and Costs; a stock supplier shows contact, website, lead days, categories, notes; a trade its login and open cases. Create and edit use the existing routes (stock: `/api/admin/inventory/suppliers`; partner: `/api/admin/laundry/suppliers`, which nulls omitted fields, so team and link changes resend the whole record, `lib/suppliers/partner-body.ts`). One laundry login, one partner: still the single `User.laundrySupplierId`; the editor and the link dialog name the partner a login leaves ("Tom leaves CleanCo, and joins Linen Lab…") and save only after "Move and continue". Laundry › Suppliers keeps working and links to the directory filtered to laundry partners.

**Pipeline actions as drawn** (`components/v2/admin/laundry/laundry-nudge.tsx`, `laundry-request-dialog.tsx`, `lib/laundry/nudge-rules.ts`). Labels: "Ask laundry team: confirm pickup", "Ask laundry team: move pickup" (new kind `TEAM_MOVE_PICKUP`: pickup day reached and the bags not out; optional proposed time sent with the question, never written to the run), "Ask laundry team: drop time" (was "…confirm drop-off"), "Ask laundry team: when will it be back?" (run panel; on lane cards "Chase supplier" stands in over turnaround), "Ask laundry team for photo" (now to the team member who recorded the drop-off when they are on the run's team, else the whole team), "Ask cleaner: bags out?". Each card shows who it goes to ("To CleanCo: Tom, Mia", "Bags: Jane · pickup: CleanCo", "To Mia, who delivered", "To CleanCo's stored email or phone"). A drop card without a planned time says "No drop time". The dialog: "<property> · job … · due …", "Send to <partner> by" Laundry portal inbox (n logins) / Push to their phones / Email their login addresses (INBOX is part of PUSH, so both send once; `normalizeTeamTransports`), note, Send; after sending "Requested HH:mm", one line per transport (`lib/laundry/team-request-receipt.ts`) and "None of these confirms anyone has read it. Asking again is possible after 30 minutes." The routing ("Who laundry requests go to") is a closed disclosure under the Pipeline. Server: `laundryTeamRequestSchema` accepts INBOX and `proposedTime`; the audit row records them and `toDeliverer`; the inbox link points at `/v2/laundry/requests`. The run panel shows "Laundry team answered" (newest first, 14 days) from the pipeline payload and the single-run read. Wording: part `move-pickup` added to `laundry.team_request` (default title "Can you collect later today?").

**Team answers** (`LaundryTeamRequestReply`; `lib/laundry/team-request-reply-rules.ts`, `team-request-replies.ts`; `POST /api/laundry/office-requests/[requestId]/reply`, LAUNDRY only, never while impersonating). Answers per request: confirm pickup / move pickup / drop time → Confirmed (optional time) or Can't (reason required); when will it be back → Back by (day required, not in the past; optional time); photo → Can't (reason); Message (note) for all, which does not settle the request. The person must have been asked or be on the run's partner team now, and see the run under the laundry visibility rule; one idempotency key is one answer (a retry replays; the same key for another answer is 409; a double tap is decided by the unique key). Audited `LAUNDRY_TEAM_REQUEST_REPLIED`. An answer records what the team said; it never changes the run (dates, planned times and status change only through their own actions). Rows survive the account (name kept, link set null) and go with the run. CHECK constraints: answer value, `HH:mm`, a return answer has a day.

**Laundry partner portal** (`app/v2/laundry/**`, `components/v2/laundry/portal/*`). Phone tabs Today, Runs, Tracking, History, More (`lib/navigation/mobile-tabs.ts`); the header carries "From the office" with its open count (`/api/laundry/attention-counts` key `/v2/laundry/requests`, PortalShell `headerActions`); `/v2/laundry/more` is the menu again (Queue, Route builder and draft, Calendar, Reports, Stats, Invoices, Team hub, Profile, Settings, From the office, and the account block that the phone drawer held). Today: date, "Today's linen.", "Route started 8:10 · stop 4 of 7"; the route in order with planned times and done / now / next facts from recorded data (`lib/laundry/today-route.ts`, same laundry scope as the boards; without a route, today's scoped stops by planned time; a draft says so with "Resume draft route"); Edit route order, Open in Maps (remaining stops), "Go to stop N · Property"; then From the office, today's figures, plan brief, live queue and the route map / runner (GPS while a route is active), all kept. Stop (`/v2/laundry/stop/<task>?kind=pickup|drop`, read with the week feed's visibility and redaction): cleaner says (ready, bags, where, photo), property access (shared `PropertyAccessDetails`) with "Report access problem", "Was the linen ready?" (required when the cleaner did not confirm, as before), bag stepper against the expected count (a difference needs a reason and photo and opens the existing office review), pickup photo, key photo and note, bag QR check against the run, "Confirm pickup · N bags" and "Pickup failed, report it" (existing failed-pickup path); a drop stop opens the existing drop-off dialog. Unsent answers are kept on the phone per login and stop; "No signal" says nothing is sent; a 409 or no answer is "may or may not have been recorded, refresh". Tracking: stage chips (To pick up / At laundry / To drop / Done, counts over the loaded dates), "Day n of m" at the laundry, Issues (failed pickups of the last week with the reschedule or pending decision; count differences stay in "Bag count differences"). "Ready to return" is not built: no stored field says a set is ready before it is dropped. From the office (`/v2/laundry/requests`): open requests with badge, time, reminder number, title, the office's note and the answers above plus "Go to stop" (the run's own action); Answered lists typed answers and requests the run no longer needs.

**Tests.** `tests/lib/supplier-directory-view.test.ts`, `tests/lib/laundry-team-replies.test.ts`, `tests/lib/laundry-portal-redesign.test.ts`, `tests/components/laundry-portal-requests.test.tsx`, `tests/db/laundry-team-replies.test.ts` (PostgreSQL); changed on purpose: `tests/components/estate-suppliers-laundry-partners.test.tsx` (the directory), `tests/components/office-actions-ui.test.tsx` (drawn labels, routing, dialog), `tests/components/laundry-dashboard.test.tsx` (Today route list, From the office card), `tests/lib/laundry-nudges.test.ts` (move pickup).

## Approvals, Quotes and pricing, Settings home, Activity log and Growth redesign (2026-11-12)

Owner: "build all designs as drawn" for the boards "Approvals", "Quotes and pricing", "Settings", "Activity" and "Growth" (the "Quote builder" and "Messages" boards are not built in this step; see the plan). No schema change, no `lib/rbac/**` change.

**Approvals** (`/v2/admin/approvals`, `components/v2/admin/approvals/*`, `lib/admin/approvals/*`). Header line with real totals ("N requests waiting · M older than 24 hours"; "at least" when a queue is longer than the rows read), Oldest / Newest first, tabs Waiting N / Decided. Left: queues grouped Pay and time / Jobs and clients / Laundry and quality with real counts, empty queues folded under "Empty queues N" (opened automatically for a deep-linked empty queue; a labelled select below `lg`). Middle: the queue (or All waiting) as `EDataTable` — Requested by, Job, Type (pay requests: Extra time / Parking / Reimbursements / Fixed amount), Asked, Waiting (red after 24 h), one primary action, "more" (Review in panel, View job / property / pay request, Decline). Primary: Approve where the decision needs nothing chosen (pay requests only with a receipt, after a confirm of the asked amount), Review otherwise (opens the panel), Review job / Open laundry for the two review-and-route queues; skips and false confirmations are always reviewed first. Right: `ESidePanel` on `?open=<id>` with What was asked, Context, the queue's own Decision controls (same routes and bodies as before: pay amount, note, "Visible to the cleaner" now sends the note as `decisionMessage` when ticked and as the private `adminNote` when not — before, the private note was labelled as visible; send to client; clock minutes; counter-offer accept; ETA reply / publish report; booking date move and decline reason; score adjustment with reason; payment-claim receipt) and History. `?queue=` and `?tab=decided` (also `?tab=history`) deep links. `GET /api/admin/all-approvals` now returns real `count` totals for every capped queue and reads capped queues oldest first (100 rows each), and pay requests carry `attachmentUrls`.

Bulk (new): `POST /api/admin/approvals/bulk { queue, decision, ids ≤ 50, note?, noteVisibleToPayee? }`. Allowed only where the decision needs nothing per request (`APPROVAL_QUEUES[*].bulk` in `lib/admin/approvals/queues.ts`): pay requests decline only (one note), clock reject only, timing, rectifications, bonuses, client approvals (a counter-offer or a pay request sent to the client is refused per row), client requests (Mark handled / Dismiss), reschedules, skips, QA reworks, QA outcomes (approve only), false confirmations, pay claims ("Not paid yet" only). Refused with the reason: pay request approve (own amount), clock approve (own minutes), bookings (job creation / emailed reason), management reviews (score and reason), pay-claim confirm (receipt per claim). Each row runs the queue's existing route handler in process with the panel's body, so its guards, notifications and approval-history row are unchanged; an operations manager is also checked against the single route's own access area (e.g. Payroll for pay requests) with `canUseOpsPath`. Per-row outcomes done / refused (reason) / no change; refused rows stay selected. The row menu's Decline is a one-row bulk decline.

Decided tab: table (Decided, Request, Decision with amount and "now", By, more), filter chips Queue / Decided by / Dates and search, "Show older decisions" (cursor). More: Open, Change amount (reason now required in the dialog), Reverse decision, Delete record. Delete now sends the PIN or password to `POST /api/admin/approvals/history/[id]`, which verifies it with `verifySensitiveAction` before deleting (before, only the browser checked it).

**Quotes and pricing** (`/v2/admin/quotes`, `components/v2/admin/quotes/pipeline/*`, `lib/quotes/pipeline*.ts`, `lib/quotes/quotes-tabs.ts`). Header (h1 "Quotes and pricing", Export, "New quote ▾": New quote, Repair quote from a case) and tabs Leads and quotes (with "N new"), Rate card (lock icon), Price book, Holiday rates, Pricing variables, Client rates in `?tab=` (old `leads`, `quotes`, `pricing`, `pricebook` names map). `/v2/admin/pricing` redirects to `?tab=rate-card`. List: `GET /api/admin/quotes/pipeline` (leads without a quote plus every quote, filtered, counted, sorted and paged on the server via `list-query`; unknown sort or stage → 400; `?format=csv` capped at 2,000 rows). Stages: New, Contacted (lead statuses), Quoted (lead quoted, draft / sent / accepted quotes), Won (converted), Lost (declined quotes, lost leads), Open = New + Contacted + Quoted. Filters: search, Service, Recurring only (kept from the old Recurring view). Columns Enquiry, Service, Value (estimate for leads), Margin, Status, Updated; one next step per row (`pipelinePrimary`): Make quote (`/quotes/new?leadId=`), Counter offer (contacted lead with an estimate; existing counter-offer route), Send (draft), Follow up (sent), Book jobs (accepted), Open job / View; more: View, Open quote, Export PDF, Send / Email again (recipient editable, default the client's or lead's email), Assign to client, Delete quote; leads: Make quote, Counter offer, Convert to client / View client, Dismiss lead. Margin uses the margin-floor model the quote routes already use (cleaner cost ÷ rack rate share of positive lines) and shows Unknown when the rate card or price cannot support it. Bulk `POST /api/admin/quotes/pipeline/bulk`: Send (quotes, through the existing send route) and Mark lost (leads, through the existing lead PATCH), per-row outcomes. Side panel: quote lines, GST, total, margin check, the existing activity timeline, Send / Open quote / PDF; lead contact, estimate, status select and lead actions. Pricing tabs compose the existing editors: Rate card and Price book behind the same PIN lock as the old page (one unlock opens both), price book editable by administrators only; Holiday rates and Pricing variables for administrators (as in Settings); Client rates = the property billing-rate editor for a chosen property. New quote accepts `?clientId=` (active client, checked on the server) and `?leadId=` (existing lead) to preselect the recipient; an unknown id shows a notice; `?fromCase=` is unchanged and wins.

**Settings home** (`/v2/admin/settings` without `?tab=`, `components/v2/admin/settings/settings-home.tsx`, `lib/admin/settings-home*.ts`). Every catalog category and destination at once from `availableSettings` (the same role filter as the category navigation; nothing new registered), "Admin" marks for administrators on admin-only destinations, search over every word of name and description that also finds Rate card, Price book and Client rates on Quotes and pricing, a Settings audit header link (administrators), Needs attention and Recently changed (administrators, from the settings audit rows). State badges only from stored facts: Xero sign-in lapsed / needs one reconnect, SMS failures in the last 24 hours (`readNotificationHealth`). The project overview card stays below. Every `?tab=` page is unchanged.

**Activity log** (`/v2/admin/activity`, `components/v2/admin/activity/activity-log.tsx`, `lib/admin/activity*.ts`). Administrators only. Filters: period (default last 7 days; old links with `entity` / `q` / `user` mean all time), record type, person (`person`, old `user`), action words; chips Everything, Access and accounts, Money, Jobs, Settings, Done while testing as someone, System, each with a count for the same filters. Rows read as sentences; "Who" is the actual person: the system label, or the account in `after.impersonatedBy` (or `impersonationActorId`) with "testing as <signed-in account>", so a Test as action is never credited to the person viewed (an unknown actual account reads "Unknown account (testing)"). A row opens to the changed fields (secrets hidden), the job link and the raw before / after. Paging through `list-query` (50 per page; unknown sort refused). Export CSV: `GET /api/admin/activity/export` with the same filters, ADMIN only, newest 5,000 with a line saying when capped.

**Growth** (`/v2/admin/growth`, `components/v2/admin/growth/growth-hub.tsx`, `lib/growth/summary*.ts`). Figures for the current month in the organisation timezone: New leads (with the change on last month, or "Not enough data"), Quotes won (of quotes made this month), Campaign emails (recipients, "Opens not recorded" until the provider reports an open), Applicants (to review). Blocks Leads and quotes (stage counts, next two to act on), Marketing (latest campaigns), Website and blog (published posts, drafts), Hiring (Applied / Screening / Interview / Offer, positions), Outbound messages (Notifications, Messages). A block is loaded only when the viewer may open its workspace (`canUseOpsPath` for operations managers). The page now calls `requireRole([ADMIN, OPS_MANAGER])` itself.

**Tests.** `tests/lib/approvals-bulk.test.ts`, `tests/api/approvals-bulk-route.test.ts`, `tests/api/approvals-history-delete-pin.test.ts`, `tests/components/approvals-workspace.test.tsx`, `tests/lib/quotes-pipeline.test.ts`, `tests/api/quotes-pipeline-routes.test.ts`, `tests/components/quote-new-prefill.test.tsx`, `tests/components/settings-home.test.tsx`, `tests/lib/activity-log.test.ts`, `tests/lib/growth-summary.test.ts`; existing `tests/components/approvals-queue-deep-link.test.tsx` unchanged and passing.

## Quote full page and Messages redesign (2026-11-12)

Owner: "build all designs as drawn" for the boards "Quote full page: detail and edit combined" and "Messages". No schema change; nothing in `prisma/**`, `lib/rbac/**`, the quotes pipeline list, the notifications area or any portal edited. Every write goes through a route that already existed; no route was changed.

**Quote full page** (`/v2/admin/quotes/[id]`, `/v2/admin/quotes/new`; `components/v2/admin/quotes/full/*`, `components/v2/admin/quotes/builder/*`, `lib/quotes/quote-page-actions.ts`, `lib/quotes/quote-record.ts`, `lib/quotes/quote-page-data.ts`). One page views and edits a quote; `/quotes/[id]/edit` redirects to it; `/quotes/new` keeps `?fromCase=`, `?clientId=`, `?leadId=` (server-checked as before) and is the same page in create mode (Create draft, Create and send). Header: "← Quotes · Q-…", one h1 (quote heading or service, status pill), a line with client, address and the save state, Preview PDF, Copy public link, Resend (once sent), Save changes (when there are unsaved changes), the primary action and More (Create repair quote — the case's `?fromCase=` link, else New quote for this client — Open client, Open case, Export PDF, Discard unsaved changes, Delete quote with a confirm). Stage strip (`EStageBar`, new `unnumbered` stage option): Draft, Sent to client, Accepted, Converted to job, "or Declined"; a stage is done only with a recorded fact (public link minted, `acceptedAt`), otherwise "passed". Facts: Total (live builder total inc GST), Valid until (days left by the organisation's calendar), Client opened (`viewedAt` or "Not recorded"), Pricing (rate card / rate card edited / manual / not recorded, with the margin check), Requested by client.

Primary action by status (`QUOTE_PRIMARY_BY_STATUS`): Draft → Review and send (renders the email with `send?preview=1`, sends only on "Send now"); Sent → Mark won (PATCH `status: ACCEPTED`, as the status select already allowed); Accepted → Convert to job (the existing convert dialog); Converted → Open job (`convertedJobId`), else Open client; Declined → Reopen as draft (PATCH `status: DRAFT`). Unsaved changes are saved first. Convert to job (rail, `#convert` kept for the pipeline's "Book jobs" link) is disabled with its reason until the quote is accepted; the route's own refusals are unchanged.

Sections (the old builder's state and rules, split into hooks and section files; arithmetic moved, not changed — `builderTotals` is the old inline code through `calculateGstBreakdown`): 1 Addressed to (existing client / existing lead / new lead; existing property fills the service address; recipient email used as `to` when sending, prefilled with the client's or lead's email; empty = the client's delivery contacts; service address and suburb). On a saved quote the lead is shown read-only and New lead is disabled: the quote PATCH has no lead field, so the old edit page silently ignored those choices. 2 Service and pricing (service and size fields by pricing model, frequency, Calculate from rate card, pricing badge, margin check from `estimateMargin` with only the cost share sent to the browser, one lines table with rate-card and hand lines, adjustments, extras and custom extras, an add row for a line item, a catalog extra by name or a custom extra with cleaner instructions, the extras catalog and pricing variables as lazy disclosures, Included / Not included / Checklist with the per-quote checklist editor). 3 Discount and coupon (coupon checked against live campaigns or manual amount, staged and applied by the discount route on save) and Totals. 4 Quote and email presentation (heading, subject, message, Email preview, reference photos, Show add-on prices). The notes META now also records `pricingSource` (provenance only; no route prices from it).

Saving is explicit: the quote PATCH has no stale-write token, so the board's autosave was not built (see `docs/style/operational-ui.md`, builder conventions). *Superseded 2026-11-13: the PATCH now has the token and the page autosaves; see "Quote autosave and office notes" below.* Fields freeze while saving and keep their values on failure; after a save the page re-reads `GET /api/admin/quotes/[id]` and re-seeds (a superseded reload is dropped). Edit lock unchanged: only a converted quote's service, pricing and presentation are read-only (reason shown); its status, valid until, notes and add-on price visibility still save (the notes' META block is kept verbatim; before, the detail page's Notes box showed and re-saved the raw META text). Rail: Client requested add-ons first (price, Add to quote, Dismiss, Add all, Add all and review email; waits while there are unsaved changes because it rewrites the saved quote), Status and details (status, valid until, notes with Regenerate), Convert to job, Send and share (Preview, Email preview, Export PDF, Copy public link, Resend), Activity (existing timeline, times now in the organisation timezone via an optional `timezone` prop). The old `window.prompt` for the send recipient is gone (the recipient field is used).

**Messages** (`/v2/admin/messages`; `components/v2/admin/messages/inbox/*`, `lib/messages/thread-model.ts`, `lib/messages/compose-checks.ts`). One page: conversations, the open thread and the composer. Header: h1 Messages, unread count, Templates (Forms → Message templates), New message. Section row: Client conversations N, Composed messages (link to the notifications delivery log, where composer sends are recorded). Conversations: search (also finds clients with no messages yet, to start one), chips All / Unread / Waiting on us with counts over the clients the list route read ("N+" when the 200-client cap is reached), unread badges, "Staff chat lives in Workforce" (`/admin/workforce`). Thread: author per message (a client assistant reads "Name, assistant"), times and day labels in the organisation timezone, office messages "Saved · not read yet" until the client opens them, then "Read"; messages about a job show Open job; reply box with Insert template (resolved for the client through `/preview` before insertion so no raw variables are posted) and Send; a reply shows Sending…, then the saved message, or stays with "Not saved: reason", Retry and Discard. Drafts are kept per conversation. Composer (`?compose=1`; `/v2/admin/messages/compose` redirects there keeping its query; the classic `?recipient=<clientId>` preselects an active client, checked on the server): To (clients and users), Template, Email / SMS / Both as explicit choices, each disabled with the reason when the recipient lacks the contact, Subject, Message, Filled from (client or user from the recipient, one of the client's properties, job ID, quote ID) with a check that every variable has a source (unsourced variables are named; the route leaves them blank), live preview, Send email / Send SMS / Send email and SMS. "Both" is two requests to the unchanged send route; each channel's outcome is shown (handed over — delivery not confirmed, not sent — provider not configured, failed — reason) and Retry failed resends only failed channels. Send is disabled with "Your access does not include sending from the composer" when `can(session, "messages.compose_send")` is false (read by the server page; the route still enforces it). From `lg` the page has three columns (the composer appears with New message); below `lg` they are stacked views with back navigation.

**Tests.** `tests/lib/quote-page-actions.test.ts` (status → primary action, secondary actions, convert disabled until won, edit lock, stages, repair link), `tests/lib/quote-builder-payload.test.ts` (totals equal the old builder's code for the same input, coupon amounts, META, create / edit bodies incl. prefill recipients, discount bodies, seed from a stored quote), `tests/components/quote-full-page.test.tsx` (one h1, Mark won PATCH, convert disabled until won, Review and send on drafts, add-on accept / dismiss bodies, converted read-only and Open job, new quote prefill), `tests/lib/messages-compose-checks.test.ts` (transports and reasons, variable sources, send blocks, outcomes, counts, filters, authors, read state, day labels, stacked navigation), `tests/components/messages-page.test.tsx` (compose redirect keeps query, server capability and recipient, read receipts and authors, failed reply with Retry, SMS / Both disabled and explicit email send, send blocked without the capability). Existing `tests/components/quote-new-prefill.test.tsx` passes unchanged.

## QA and maintenance owner decisions: inspector visit order, Fail verdict, five maintenance outcomes, rework scope (2026-11-13)

Owner decisions of 2026-11-12, building four items the "QA portal, maintenance portal, sign in and public pages" section above listed as not built (inspector reordering, a single "Fail", offer-back progress in Rework) plus the maintenance outcome merge. Migrations `20261113020000_qa_day_order`, `20261113021000_qa_fail_verdict`, `20261113022000_maintenance_outcome_merge` (forward only; QA and maintenance models only).

- **Inspector visit order (QA Today).** New `QaDayOrder` (inspector + Sydney DATE, `locked`, `setByOffice`, `setById`/`setAt`, `unlockedById`/`unlockedAt`; CHECK: only the office locks) records who set an inspector's day; the order itself stays in `QaAssignment.sequence`. Service `lib/qa/day-order.ts`, serialised per inspector-day with an advisory lock. Inspector path `PATCH /api/qa/visit-order` (`requireRole([QA_INSPECTOR])`, refused while impersonated, only their own OPEN/ASSIGNED/IN_PROGRESS assignments for that Sydney day, the list must be exactly that day, `expectedOrder` must equal the stored order or 409 `STALE_ORDER`, audited `QA_VISIT_ORDER_SELF_REORDER`); `GET` returns the caller's own lock state. Office path unchanged in rights (`PATCH /api/admin/qa/assignments/reorder`, ADMIN/OPS_MANAGER with quality at manage through the live ops check) now resolves `date` (today / tomorrow / YYYY-MM-DD; an unreadable date is 400) and records the office as the setter; ordering another inspector's day locks it (an office member ordering their own day does not). While locked the inspector is refused with "Order set by the office" (409 `OFFICE_LOCK`, with who and when). `GET`/`DELETE /api/admin/qa/day-order` reads and clears the lock ("Let inspector reorder", audited `QA_VISIT_ORDER_UNLOCK`; the order stays). UI: QA Today shows Move earlier / later for inspectors when the day is open (`inspectorMayReorder`, false while testing as someone), "Order set by the office · Set by … · time" when locked, and keeps the arrows off if the lock state cannot be read; the day chips freeze while saving; a stale or locked answer restores the order. The office day planner shows "Locked by / Set by / Planned by …" per column with "Let inspector reorder".
- **QA "Fail" replaces Major and Critical for new inspections.** How it worked before: deductions are global settings (`settings.accountability.scoring`), not per template: Minor 3, Major 10, Critical 25; Critical alone also set MANAGEMENT_REVIEW (`criticalTriggersManagementReview`), notified management, broke the bonus streak (`hadCritical` in `lib/accountability/streaks.ts` and `lib/workforce/performance.ts`), and made the inspection brief "danger". No verdict creates rework (rework comes only from "rework required"). Now: `QaAssignment.verdictScale` (`FAIL` default; the migration stamped every inspection that was IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, had a draft, was picked up or had its timer started as `MAJOR_CRITICAL`). FAIL scale offers Pass / Minor / Fail / N/A; a Fail has an optional **Serious** tick. New settings `failDeduction` and `seriousFailDeduction`; when never saved they read the organisation's own `majorDeduction` (default 10) and `criticalDeduction` (default 25), so the change moves no score; both are edited in Settings → Accountability (Major / Critical stay editable under "Inspections begun before 13 Nov 2026"). Storage keeps the existing severity grouping: Fail = `QaIssue.severity` MAJOR + `failVerdict`; Fail + Serious = CRITICAL + `failVerdict` + `serious` (CHECKs enforce both). Consequence decisions: Fail triggers what Major triggered (deduction, written-up issue, patterns, Medium band); Serious carries every Critical-only consequence (its deduction, management review and notice, streak break, performance "critical" count, brief "danger", High band) — all automatic because they key off CRITICAL severity or `managementReview`. The submit route refuses verdicts outside the assignment's scale (409 `VERDICT_SCALE_MISMATCH`) instead of re-mapping, so an in-progress or reopened older inspection keeps Major / Critical until completed and a new one cannot record them. History is not touched: no existing QaIssue, QAReview or QaFormSubmission row is updated; Major / Critical keep their words everywhere ("Major (before 13 Nov 2026)" only in the Quality hub legend). Labels: `lib/qa/verdict-scale.ts` (`qaIssueVerdictLabel`, `countIssuesByVerdict`, `SEVERITY_GROUPING_LEGEND`).
- **Severity / verdict enumeration audit (changed):** `lib/accountability/scoring.ts`, `components/v2/qa/accountability.ts` (options per scale, guide, explainer, preview, blob), `components/v2/qa/qa-inspection-workspace.tsx` and `components/qa/qa-job-client.tsx` (buttons per scale, Serious tick, preview rows, off-scale draft warning), `app/api/qa/jobs/[id]/route.ts` (scale on GET, refusal and storage on POST, notice summary), `lib/settings.ts`, both accountability settings screens, `lib/reports/qa-report.ts` (Fail rows and chip), `lib/notifications/qa-result-email.ts` + `lib/notifications/accountability.ts`, `app/api/cleaner/qa-feedback/route.ts` + `components/v2/cleaner/qa-feedback-card.tsx`, `components/admin/qa-issues-workspace.tsx`, `components/v2/admin/quality/hub/stat-cards.tsx` (legend), `lib/qa/brief-rules.ts` (wording), `lib/quality/severity.ts` (doc). **Unchanged on purpose:** Quality hub Low / Medium / High mapping and filters, groupings, patterns, streaks, workforce performance, adjust / issue-review / photo-review management-review recomputation (CRITICAL count), accountability overview, v1 dashboards (counts include Fail in Major and serious Fail in Critical), Cases "Raise QA issue" (an office severity, not an inspection verdict), damage and case severities, rework transfer severities (MINOR / MODERATE / MAJOR, a different scale), QA template builder (has no verdict field type).
- **Maintenance outcomes: the five drawn.** `MaintenanceOutcome` is now REPLACED_OR_REPAIRED, NEEDS_PARTS, NEEDS_FOLLOWUP, NO_ACCESS, NO_ISSUE_FOUND. Mapping: FIXED → Replaced or repaired, REPLACED → Replaced or repaired, OTHER → Needs follow-up (an unclassified result is not claimed as fixed), the other four unchanged. The migration first copies every recorded outcome into the new text column `PropertyMaintenanceItem.originalOutcome`, then swaps the enum (new type, column cast with the mapping, old type dropped), then clears the copy where nothing changed. History views show "Replaced or repaired (originally: Replaced)". `lib/maintenance/visit-outcomes.ts` holds the five, `LEGACY_OUTCOME_MAP`, labels and the "originally" note; `POST /api/maintenance/[id]/visit` accepts an earlier value from a screen that has not reloaded (mapped, original kept) and refuses unknown text (400). **Outcome enumeration audit:** changed — visit-outcomes, outcome-choice (reads it), v2 visit workspace and v1 worker visit client (default and display), visit route and `lib/maintenance/workers.ts`, maintenance Log, v1 and v2 admin maintenance detail; unchanged — ticket stage (its three values kept), tickets and `/api/maintenance/mine` (stage only), the notification line (renders the label), client portal maintenance (generic prettifier reads "Replaced or repaired"; not edited, no "originally" shown to clients), no maintenance CSV export exists, no mobile app sends outcomes.
- **Rework list scope.** `lib/qa/rework-list.ts`: an inspector sees transfers they raised, on inspections assigned to or picked up by them, or whose rework clean is assigned to them; ADMIN / OPS_MANAGER see all, with Mine / All chips when they also inspect (QA_INSPECTOR held, or OPS_MANAGER). Applied in the query on `/v2/qa/rework`, the Today "Rework open" figure ("yours" / "team-wide") and the Rework tab badge (`/api/qa/attention-counts`). Offer-back progress from stored facts: the rework clean's status (Waiting / In progress / Rework done), else the offer to the cleaner (Waiting, In progress when accepted, Offer declined / expired); nothing shown when neither exists. QA Stats stays team-wide.
- **Verification.** Fresh database, a seeded copy at the previous migration with all seven outcomes and Major / Critical inspections (before → after: FIXED 3 + REPLACED 2 → REPLACED_OR_REPAIRED 5; NEEDS_FOLLOWUP 2 + OTHER 2 → NEEDS_FOLLOWUP 4; others and "no outcome" unchanged; QAReview, QaIssue and QaFormSubmission rows byte-identical), and the existing `sneek_ui` (already deployed); repeat deploy reports nothing pending; `migrate diff` shows no difference.

## Laundry owner decisions: partner weight, price and drop-off photos, team answer sets the time, Ready to return, partner schedule (2026-11-13)

Owner decisions on the laundry partner portal. This supersedes two statements in "Suppliers directory, laundry partner pipeline actions and the laundry partner portal" above: "Ready to return" is now built, and a team answer "Yes, <time>" now sets the planned time. Two forward migrations: `20261113010000_laundry_ready_to_return_status` (only `ALTER TYPE "LaundryStatus" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'READY_TO_RETURN' AFTER 'PICKED_UP'`, in its own file because a new enum value cannot be used in the same transaction) and `20261113010100_laundry_partner_schedule` (six additive columns on `LaundrySupplier` with CHECK constraints; no existing row changes).

**1. Weight, price and drop-off photos from the laundry team (all optional).** Three portal write routes: `POST /api/laundry/[taskId]/weight-price` (`weightKg?`, `price?`, at least one, each above 0), `POST /api/laundry/[taskId]/dropoff-photos` (`photoKeys`, 1 to 4) and `POST /api/laundry/[taskId]/ready-to-return`. All three go through `lib/laundry/partner-entry-http.ts`: live `requireRole([LAUNDRY])`, refused while impersonating. `lib/laundry/partner-entries.ts` then locks the run and checks it again in one transaction. The account must be active, and the run's property must be visible under the laundry visibility rule (`propertyIsVisibleToLaundry`, the same rule as every portal action). The run must not belong to another laundry partner (`partnerMayWriteRun`: a run with no partner, or a login with no partner, uses the visibility rule alone). The run's `updatedAt` must match the version the screen loaded, otherwise the write is refused with 409. Status gates: weight and price only while `PICKED_UP` or `READY_TO_RETURN`; photos only once `DROPPED`. Each write records a `LaundryConfirmation` event (`PARTNER_WEIGHT_PRICE`, `DROPOFF_PHOTO_ADDED`, `READY_TO_RETURN`; actor = `confirmedById`) and an AuditLog row with the actor (`LAUNDRY_PARTNER_WEIGHT_PRICE`, `LAUNDRY_DROPOFF_PHOTO_ADDED`, `LAUNDRY_READY_TO_RETURN`).

The price is the partner's stated cost for the run. It is stored in `LaundryTask.dropoffCostAud`, where laundry cost is stored today, and weight in `bagWeightKg`. No issued or paid invoice and no client charge reads or changes from it: `ClientInvoice` and its lines never read this column, and the laundry invoice report is generated on demand. Its default "dropped" date range still lists delivered runs only; a report run by pickup date shows the stated price of a set still at the laundry. A drop that leaves weight or price empty now keeps the value already entered (`loadWeightKg ?? existing`). Before this change those fields were reset to null on the drop. The drop dialog shows "Already entered: $48.20. Leave empty to keep it."

Photos are appended. Each photo is its own confirmation row; no earlier row, photo or receipt is replaced. Only the caller's own uploads are accepted (`findForeignUploadKeys`). A photo added this way counts for the "No drop photo" exception (`hasDropPhoto` accepts `DROPOFF_PHOTO_ADDED`), so the office's photo request is then marked done.

Office: the run panel shows "Cost $48.20 · Entered by Tom" and "Weight 11.2 kg · Entered by Tom" while the stored figure is still the partner's entry (`partnerCostEntry`). A later save of the same figure, such as the Edit form resending the stored price, keeps the attribution. Any office correction with a different figure removes it. The office corrects these values in Edit as today; Edit now also has "Load weight (kg)" (admin PATCH `loadWeightKg`, sent only when changed, recorded on the evidence event).

Portal UI as the board draws it: on Tracking cards, the drop stop and From the office request cards, the laundry login sees "Add weight / price (optional)", "Ready to return" and "Add drop-off photo (optional)", each by status (`components/v2/laundry/portal/partner-run-entries.tsx`). Fields freeze while sending. A refused or unanswered save keeps the typed draft and says "may or may not have been saved; refresh". Drafts reset when the run changes. Office accounts and impersonated sessions do not see these controls.

**2. A team answer "Yes, <time>" sets the planned time.** In `recordTeamRequestReply`, in the same transaction as the reply, `applyPlannedTimeFromAnswer` locks the run and sets `pickupTime` (confirm pickup or move pickup, while `PENDING`, `CONFIRMED` or `FLAGGED`) or `dropoffTime` (confirm drop, while `PICKED_UP` or `READY_TO_RETURN`). This happens only when the answer is CONFIRMED with a valid `HH:mm` time and the leg is still open (`plannedTimeFromAnswer`). It is audited as `LAUNDRY_PLANNED_TIMES_UPDATED` with `source: LAUNDRY_TEAM_ANSWER`, `label: "Set from laundry team's answer"` and the reply and request ids. It never changes the date, the status or any schedule rule. A replayed key does not apply it again, and any other answer does not lock the run. The office changes the time afterwards as today (Set planned times). The reply response carries `plannedTimeSet`.

**3. "Ready to return" is a status.** `READY_TO_RETURN` sits between `PICKED_UP` and `DROPPED`. It is marked by the laundry team (Tracking, drop stop, From the office) and can be set or undone by the office: Edit status lists it, and the status route's `REVERT_TO_PICKED_UP` and `REVERT_TO_CONFIRMED` accept it. Marking ready is optional: a drop is accepted from `PICKED_UP` or `READY_TO_RETURN`. Shared helpers are in `lib/laundry/status-groups.ts`. Admin Pipeline: inside "At the laundry", ready sets are their own group, "Ready to return N", under the sets still being washed. Their card pill reads "Ready to return · day n of m". Drop cards add "ready to return". Lane counts are unchanged. Status enumeration audit, with the decision for each place:
- **Treated like PICKED_UP** (picked up, not yet delivered): Pipeline lanes, the day query and the In transit tile (`pipeline.ts`, `pipeline-server.ts`). Exceptions DROP_OVERDUE and OVER_TURNAROUND. Tracking stages and "Day n of m". Team request kinds (when back? / drop time) and Chase supplier. Reschedule (only the drop-off moves). Driver nudge for sets out more than 24 h, with its query. Ops stats "still out" and its query (`ops-stats.ts`, `stats-load.ts`, v1 `admin/laundry/stats`). Stuck detection (`accountability/laundry-stats.ts` `STUCK_STATUSES`, `team-metrics.ts` query). Directory partner figures (to drop, at the laundry, late; `directory-load.ts`). Route-builder overdue drop candidates (`week-feed.ts`). Portal Today route (`today-route.ts`; the pickup leg counts as done in `today-stops.ts`). Portal home "in transit" and its query (`app/v2/laundry/page.tsx`; the test expectation was changed on purpose). Portal stats "late returns" and the status tiles (`app/v2/laundry/stats`). Attention count "out for cleaning". Admin live: overdue at laundry (`api/admin/laundry/live`) and in transit (`laundry-live.tsx`). Stop screen and stop page (the drop is allowed). Route map runner and next stop (the drop is allowed). Portal boards: Runs loops and done counts, Tracking (drop, undo, overdue, QR scan). v1 laundry portal (`app/laundry/page.tsx`, `app/laundry/today/page.tsx`). The cleaner status update never moves a ready set back (`cleaner-status.ts`, both guards). The planner treats it as completed and human-owned (`planner.ts` `isLaundryTaskCompleted`; `canPlannerOverrideStatus` was already PENDING and FLAGGED only). Property portfolio "open laundry" (`portfolio-facts.ts`). Custody holder and next step (`investigation.ts`). Report view model (counted as ready, outcome "PICKED UP").
- **Own label "Ready to return"**: `laundry-shared.ts` (label, tone, edit options), board `STATUS_LABEL`/`STATUS_TONE`, history board, calendar colour and legend, invoice report status label and "all statuses" list, `LAUNDRY_STATUS_TONES`, job status icon, property Coming up cell, v1 admin calendar and laundry page (colours, legend, report status chips), v1 laundry calendar, v1 admin live map, run history (`media.ts`, `handoff-receipts.ts`).
- **No change, because the code already handles it correctly**: Calendar laundry counts (`lib/calendar/load.ts` counts by date; only SKIPPED_PICKUP is excluded). `notIn [DROPPED, SKIPPED_PICKUP]` queries, which already include it as open (`ops/tomorrow-prep.ts`, `ops/admin-attention-summary.ts`, `briefing/cleaner-briefing.ts`, plan brief, route candidates `DROP_CLOSED`). Deletion (only DROPPED counts as completed, so ready sets are in flight). Previous-cycle card, cleaner laundry ETA and cleaner briefing (keyed on the DROPPED event or `droppedAt`). Finance summary and laundry invoice amounts (keyed on drops). Work queue and v1 ops (FLAGGED and SKIPPED only). Pickup readiness and quantity pickup (PICKED_UP event). Bag custody (its own bag statuses, not the run status). `z.nativeEnum(LaundryStatus)` validators (admin create and edit, generate-week, client laundry filter, report filters, sync draft) include it automatically. Job reset (back to PENDING). Notifications: no notice reads the run status.
- **Not edited (client portal is out of scope for this change)**: `components/v2/client/laundry/laundry-workspace.tsx`, `components/v2/client/home/home-model.ts`, `components/v2/client/property/property-format.ts`, v1 `components/client/client-laundry-workspace.tsx` and `app/client/page.tsx`. They show their existing fallback: label "READY TO RETURN" or "Ready To Return", neutral tone, open run. The summary line reads "Laundry picked up" from `pickedUpAt`. A follow-up can add a friendly label there.
- **Mobile**: the root app's API routes under `app/api/**` that list laundry statuses are covered above. `mobile-app/` does not read laundry statuses.

**4. Partner pickup and drop schedule (descriptive defaults only).** The rules that apply now are unchanged: `computeDraftItem` sets pickup to the clean day + 1 and drop-off to the day before the next known clean (at least pickup + 1, with the fallback or fast return from Laundry operations). Key-lost runs have same-day times on the date itself. New `LaundrySupplier` fields: `pickupWeekdays` / `dropWeekdays` (`INTEGER[]`, 0 = Sunday, CHECK 0..6, default empty) and `pickupWindowStart/End` / `dropWindowStart/End` (`HH:mm`, CHECK). Pure rules are in `lib/laundry/partner-schedule.ts`; server code in `partner-schedule-server.ts`. Edited in Inventory › Suppliers › partner panel › Schedule: day toggles and windows, save via `PATCH /api/admin/laundry/suppliers/[id]/schedule` (ADMIN and OPS_MANAGER, version check, audited `LAUNDRY_PARTNER_SCHEDULE_UPDATED`). Shown on the Overview as drawn ("Pickups Mon to Sat, 13:00 to 16:00 · Drops … · Sunday No service"). The table says "no pickup schedule" when none is recorded. The laundry portal More page shows the team member's own partner schedule. The run panel's planned times show "<partner> usually: pickups … · drops …" and note when a run's day is not one of the stated days. Prefill: when a NEW run is created, the window start becomes the planned time, but only when no time is set and the day is a stated day (or no days are stated). This covers the planner apply (create branch only), `ensureLaundryTaskForJob` in a transaction, admin "Add run" and onboarding approval. Key-lost runs are never prefilled. The partner is the run's supplier, otherwise the single partner of the property's assigned laundry team. No supplier is written to the run. The lookup runs outside the creating transaction and is best-effort: a failed lookup leaves no time and never blocks the run. Dates, statuses, the planner's date and turnaround rules, exception rules and existing runs never change; a schedule edit touches no run. Empty means nothing is prefilled and nothing is shown as scheduled. The cleaner-status fallback create (non-turnover job with no planner task) is not prefilled.

**Tests.** `tests/lib/laundry-owner-decisions-1113.test.ts` (status groups and every label and tone map; lanes, exceptions, tracking, team requests, chase, reschedule, nudge with READY_TO_RETURN equal to PICKED_UP and other statuses unchanged; optional fields and gates; partner rule; "Entered by"; the planned-time rule; schedule description and prefill, never a date, key-lost, existing time wins). `tests/db/laundry-owner-decisions-1113.test.ts` (PostgreSQL: office role, impersonation, another partner, an unseen run and a stale version are refused; weight-only and price-only saves are audited with the actor; client invoice rows checksum unchanged; ready to return marked once; a drop from it keeps the entered price; drop-time answer sets `dropoffTime` with audit, a closed-leg answer sets nothing; photos append-only, own uploads only, originals byte-equal, exception cleared; pickup answer sets only `pickupTime`, the replay does not re-apply, an invalid time is refused; schedule saved, audited, version-checked; new-run times for supplier, single-partner team, mixed team, no partner and key-lost; planner create gets the time with the draft's dates and an update keeps the office's time; CHECK constraints; a cleaner's late update does not move a ready set). `tests/components/laundry-partner-entries.test.tsx`. Changed on purpose: `tests/components/laundry-dashboard.test.tsx` (the portal home query includes READY_TO_RETURN in transit).

## Client portal, approvals and own PIN owner decisions: booking prefill, quote numbers, clean costs, payment return, approval delete, bulk pay approval, own PIN (2026-11-13)

Owner decisions of 2026-11-13. Left uncommitted in the working tree. Two forward migrations: `20261113030000_quote_reference_number` and `20261113031000_user_security_pin`. Supersedes the "Book a clean here (the booking flow takes no property pre-selection)" line of the client portal redesign, the Approvals "pay request approve" bulk refusal, and the Decided tab delete for operations managers.

**Book a clean here.** The property page links to `/v2/client/booking?propertyId=<id>`. The booking page checks the id against the list it already reads with `propertyScopeWhere` (active properties of this client, or of the assistant's team scope) via `bookingPropertyPrefill` (`lib/booking/rebook.ts`). A property in scope is preselected (`EstateBookingFlow` `initialPropertyId`; a saved draft or a rebook still wins). An unknown or out-of-scope id preselects nothing and shows "That property is not available here". The prefilled booking has its own draft key, so it never overwrites an ordinary booking draft.

**Quote reference numbers ("Q-204").** `Quote.quoteNumber` (`INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE`). The migration numbers existing quotes 1, 2, 3 … in `createdAt` order (ties by id) and seeds a `QUOTE` row in `InvoiceSequence` at the highest number. New quotes take the next number in the creating transaction with the invoice pattern's single atomic `UPDATE … SET "lastNumber" = "lastNumber" + 1 … RETURNING` (`lib/quotes/quote-number.ts`, used by `POST /api/admin/quotes` and the lead counter-offer route). A failed save rolls the number back, and the counter only moves forward, so a number is never on two quotes and a deleted quote's number is never issued again. Unlike invoices there is no random fallback: if the counter cannot be read, no quote is created (503). One formatter, `formatQuoteReference` (`lib/quotes/quote-reference.ts`, returns null rather than "Q-0"). It is used on the admin Quotes list, panel, search and CSV (`pipeline.ts` reference), the quote full page title and delete dialog (`shortQuoteRef(snapshot)`, snapshot carries `quoteNumber`), the quote PDF and email body ("Quote #"), the public quote page, the office add-on / response alerts (existing `{{quoteRef}}` variable), the case note and case quote list, the client's My quotes ("Quotation Q-204") and the Approvals / dashboard quote card. No wording template changed.

**Clean page costs.** `clientMaySeeJobCosts` (`lib/client/job-response.ts`) is one rule for the job API and the Estate clean page: the finance module switch AND (account holder or the assistant's invoice grant). With it off, the page does not read invoice lines from the database at all, so no amount, line or invoice number reaches the page. Nothing else on the page changed.

**Payment return.** `clientPaymentReturnUrls` (`lib/billing/invoice-payment-link.ts`): Stripe checkout from `POST /api/client/invoices/[id]/payment-link` returns to `/v2/client/finance?paid=1` (success) or `/v2/client/finance?payment=cancelled` (cancel). An address typed into Integrations still wins. The new page shows "handed to the payment provider … Paid once the provider confirms it" (Paid still only from the recorded payment) and a cancelled note. The classic `/client/finance` now shows the same `?paid=1` line for links sent earlier. Invoice emails already linked to `/v2/client/finance`. The generic `/api/client/invoices/[id]/pay` route takes the caller's return URL; it has no caller in the app and was not changed.

**Delete a decided approval: administrators only.** `POST /api/admin/approvals/history/[id]` refuses `delete` with 403 unless the live session holds ADMIN (primary or extra; `isAdministrator`), before the PIN is checked. The administrator's own PIN is then verified as before. `GET /api/admin/approvals/history` returns `canDeleteRecords`, and the Decided tab shows Delete record only when it is true. Change amount and Reverse stay with operations managers.

**Bulk approve pay requests "as asked".** `APPROVAL_QUEUES.payAdjustments.bulk.approve` is now "Approve as asked". `runBulkDecision` sends the pay-request queue to `planPayApprovals` (`lib/admin/approvals/bulk.ts`). Each row is approved at its own asked amount (the cleaner's requested amount; since the 2026-11-13 rule never the client-approved charge) through the existing `PATCH /api/admin/pay-adjustments/[id]`, in process, with `{ status: APPROVED, approvedAmount }`. A row is approved only when it is still a waiting pay request, has a valid amount above zero, has a receipt attached (the list's one-click rule), has no client approval waiting or declined, and its asked amount equals the amount confirmed in the dialog (`expectedAmounts`, so a change in between is refused with both figures). The single route still checks settled money, the self-approval guard and client approval, and an operations manager is checked against Payroll access with `canUseOpsPath`. No approval limit exists for pay requests, so none is applied. Refused rows keep their reason and stay selected. The dialog lists each row with its amount, flags rows without a receipt, and shows the count and total before sending.

**Own PIN for sensitive actions.** *Before:* any ADMIN or OPS_MANAGER could keep a personal PIN (a bcrypt hash inside the `user_extended_profiles_v1` settings JSON, set from the classic profile settings only; the Estate admin profile had no PIN section). `verifySensitiveAction` accepted that PIN OR the account password. There was no shared PIN in code. Labels said "Admin PIN", which read as one shared PIN. Wrong attempts were limited only on the Test-as unlock (in memory). The id checked was the session's, so an administrator testing as an operations manager was checked against that manager's own PIN or password. *Now:*
- Storage: `UserSecurityPin` (one row per person: bcrypt hash, set time, wrong-attempt count, lock time, last reset by). The migration copies every existing bcrypt-shaped personal hash across unchanged, so everyone who had a PIN keeps it. The settings JSON is left as it was and is no longer read for PINs.
- Who: only the genuinely signed-in person, acting as themselves (`lib/security/actual-actor.ts`: the session's real id must equal the id checked, and no Test-as ticket may be active). Another person's PIN is never checked, and nothing is confirmed while testing (`ACTUAL_ACTOR_REQUIRED`). The ADMIN / OPS_MANAGER role and the sensitive-capability check (`SENSITIVE_ACTION_CAPABILITY`) are unchanged.
- Transition, exactly: a person WITH a PIN confirms with that PIN only. A password alone is refused with `PIN_REQUIRED`, and a forgotten PIN is changed in the profile with the password. A person with NO PIN (never set, removed, or reset by an administrator) is asked for their account password plus a new PIN, once. The server checks the password, stores the PIN and confirms that action. A password alone answers `PIN_SETUP_REQUIRED`. So nobody is locked out. Operations managers can no longer confirm with anything but their own PIN from their next action. The password-only path ends for each administrator at their first sensitive action after deploy (or when they set a PIN in Profile). There was never a shared admin PIN to retire.
- Lockout: 5 wrong PINs or passwords in a row (verification, profile set or remove) lock that person's verification for 15 minutes, stored on the row so every server instance sees it (audited `SECURITY_PIN_LOCKED`). A correct attempt clears the count. An administrator's reset also lifts it. PIN changes are additionally limited to 5 per 15 minutes per person (in memory).
- Profile: "Your PIN" on `/v2/admin/profile` and `/admin/profile` (`components/v2/admin/profile/own-pin-section.tsx`). `GET/POST/DELETE /api/me/admin-pin` sets, changes or removes it with the current password. These routes are refused while testing as someone, and audited `SECURITY_PIN_SET` / `SECURITY_PIN_CHANGED` / `SECURITY_PIN_REMOVED` (source profile or sensitive action) without the PIN. A PIN is 4 to 12 digits, not one digit repeated, and never shown again.
- Administrator reset: `POST /api/admin/users/[id]/reset-pin` (`requireRole([ADMIN])` live, never delegated, not on oneself, only for a person holding ADMIN or OPS_MANAGER, confirmed with the administrator's own PIN, audited `SECURITY_PIN_RESET`). It clears the PIN so the person sets a new one; nobody can see or set another person's PIN. The menu item is People › person › More › Reset PIN.
- Prompts: one shared piece, `components/v2/shared/own-pin-fields.tsx`, reads the person's own state from `GET /api/me/admin-pin`. It shows "Your PIN", or "Set your own PIN" (account password, choose and confirm PIN), with a switch either way. It is used by `EConfirmModal`, `TwoStepConfirmDialog`, the Rate card / Price book lock (`EstatePageLock`), the classic pricing lock, the Test-as lock, the job reset dialog, Access and permissions save and the clients bulk "mark inactive". Route schemas pass `newPin` through. The Rate card / Price book unlock is remembered per tab for that signed-in person only (`sneek_pagelock_pricing:<userId>`). Routes that answered 423 for a wrong or missing credential now answer 423 for every own-PIN credential refusal (`isSensitiveRefusal`). The Access and permissions screen and capability texts say "asked for their own PIN".
- Not converted: the laundry protected-removal dialog (`components/v2/laundry/laundry-delete-dialog.tsx`, out of this change's area) still sends a PIN field only. A person with no PIN gets the readable "You have no PIN yet …" refusal there and sets a PIN in Profile or in any other prompt. The admin laundry delete route keeps its own 423 mapping, so the new refusals answer 400 with that sentence.

**Client laundry status READY_TO_RETURN.** `lib/client/laundry-status.ts` is one label and tone map for the client: "Ready to come back", the same in-flight tone as Picked up, never finished or delivered. It is used by the client laundry page (label, tone, filter, headline "Laundry ready to come back"), Home / dashboard, the property Laundry tab and overview card, the jobs board, the clean page and the classic client home, laundry and jobs pages.

**Tests.** New: `tests/db/own-pin-and-quote-number.test.ts` (PostgreSQL 55439: the one-time setup, own PIN only, another person's PIN refused, wrong actor and Test as refused, lockout in the database and expiry, set / change / remove need the password, administrator reset never reveals the PIN, 12 concurrent quote creations get unique consecutive numbers, a deleted number is not reused, a failed save rolls back), `tests/api/own-pin-routes.test.ts`, `tests/lib/approvals-bulk-pay.test.ts`, `tests/lib/owner-decisions-client-quotes.test.ts`, `tests/api/client-payment-return-url.test.ts`, `tests/components/own-pin-prompts.test.tsx`, `tests/components/quote-reference-display.test.tsx`, `tests/lib/client-laundry-status.test.ts`. Extended: `tests/components/client-rebook.test.tsx` (prefill scope), `tests/components/client-visibility-redesign.test.tsx` (link, costs not read with finance off), `tests/components/client-finance-reliability.test.tsx` (return states), `tests/components/accounts-person-panel.test.tsx` (setup path, Reset PIN), `tests/api/approvals-history-delete-pin.test.ts` (ADMIN only). Changed on purpose: `tests/lib/sensitive-action-grants.test.ts` (PIN table), `tests/lib/approvals-bulk.test.ts` and `tests/api/approvals-bulk-route.test.ts` (pay approve now allowed), `tests/components/approvals-workspace.test.tsx` (approve as asked), `tests/components/access-permissions.test.tsx` (password-only save is now password plus new PIN), `tests/api/admin-user-guards.test.ts`, `tests/components/account-actions-menu.test.tsx`, `tests/components/checklist-library-save.test.tsx`, `tests/components/job-extras-save-messaging.test.tsx` ("Your PIN" label, PIN state read first), `tests/api/case-repair-quote.test.ts` (quote number in the transaction).

## Quote autosave and office notes (2026-11-13)

Owner decisions of 2026-11-13 on the quote full page. "Reopen as draft" on a declined quote is confirmed as built (no change). Migration `20261113040000_quote_internal_notes` (forward only: one nullable `TEXT` column on `Quote`, no default, no backfill; nothing else in the schema changed).

**Stale-write guard on the quote PATCH** (`app/api/admin/quotes/[id]/route.ts`, `lib/quotes/quote-stale-guard.ts`, `lib/quotes/quote-patch-write.ts`). The PATCH accepts `expectedUpdatedAt`. In one transaction it reads the row's `updatedAt`; a mismatch answers **409 `{ code: "STALE_QUOTE", currentUpdatedAt, error }`** and writes nothing. A match writes with `updateMany … where updatedAt = <stored>`, which PostgreSQL re-checks under the row lock, so of two saves sent on the same version exactly one lands (the other is 409; DB-tested). Compared as epoch milliseconds (a `+10:00` and a `Z` spelling agree); an unreadable token is stale, never "no token". Callers that send none keep the old unconditional update (pipeline, v1 pages, the mobile app). Everything that already went through the PATCH is guarded when it sends the token: the builder save, status changes (status select, Mark won, Reopen as draft), the converted quote's details save and the public-link mint (Copy public link). Send, Convert to job, client add-on accept / dismiss and Delete are separate routes and are unchanged (no token). The discount route now returns the new `updatedAt` and records its "Applied … / Removed discount" timeline event only when the stored discount actually changed (the page re-applies the staged discount after every save because the PATCH rewrites the lines without it; before, each save added the event again).

**Autosave on the quote full page** (`components/v2/admin/quotes/full/use-quote-autosave.ts`, rules in `lib/quotes/quote-autosave.ts`, banners in `quote-save-banner.tsx`; mirrors the invoice editor's Wave D design). The page owns the version token (`tokenRef`, from the server page, every reload and every write's answer); every PATCH on the page sends it. **Only while the quote's status is Draft** (coordinator decision, same day: `autosaveAppliesTo` / `mayAutosave` in the rules module). On a saved Draft quote a change to the builder (service and pricing, lines, extras, addressed-to, presentation, client notes, valid until, office notes, add-on price visibility, staged discount) is saved 1.5 s after the last change: the same edit body as the explicit save, then the discount route for a staged discount. One save at a time; edits typed meanwhile stay dirty and are saved next with the new token (newest wins). Never while a field is invalid (`quoteDraftProblem`: no priced lines, a line without a description or a finite price, an unreadable Valid until, or "no client" on a quote that has one; the header then reads "Not saved yet: <reason>"). Never on `/quotes/new` (Create draft / Create and send stay explicit; `useQuoteBuilder.save()` is now create-only) and never on a Sent, Accepted, Declined or Converted quote: those keep the explicit save exactly as before autosave ("Unsaved changes" and Save changes, which sends the token; the converted quote's status, valid until, notes, office notes and add-on visibility still save with Save). The explicit save runs through the same hook (`flush`), so it has the same serialisation and conflict banner. Autosave never sends and never changes the status: the status select still waits for Save. States in the header line and Status card: "Saving…", "Saved N seconds ago", "Unsaved changes", "Not saved" (banner with the reason and Retry; a failed save is not repeated until the draft changes or Retry), "Not saved: changed elsewhere" (banner "Reload theirs" = the page's reload, drafts discarded; "Keep my edits and retry" = re-read the version, then send the same absolute values). Typed text stays usable during a background save; an explicit save (Save changes, or the save before a primary action) freezes the fields. Review and send, Mark won, Convert to job and Reopen as draft first save (waiting for a save in flight) and stop when it did not land; buttons that write wait while a save is in flight. The leave-page warning is on only while something is unsaved, saving or in conflict (existing quotes; create mode unchanged). An autosave does not re-key the workspace (the person may be typing): the page keeps the saved record and the token, and an explicit reload (Discard unsaved changes, Reload theirs, after status and add-on actions) re-seeds as before. The builder now remembers whether the stored quote carries a discount after each save, so removing a discount that was applied in the same visit still clears it (before, the page reloaded after every save).

**Sent quotes.** The editing rule is unchanged: only a converted quote is locked, so Sent, Accepted and Declined quotes can still be edited, and the public `/q/<token>` page reads the stored quote live. Because autosave applies only to Drafts, a half-finished edit never reaches the client's online page and an accepted price never changes without a deliberate Save. A shared quote (public link minted, not draft or converted) shows "The client can already open this quote online. Your changes go live on the client's online quote when you press Save changes, not before. Nothing is emailed until you choose Resend." Remaining risks: an Accepted quote's price can still be changed by an explicit Save (as before); between the PATCH and the discount route the stored quote briefly has no discount; a discount refused on re-apply (an expired coupon) leaves the saved quote without it, and the page says exactly that ("The quote saved, but the discount was not applied … The saved quote has no discount until this is fixed.") and keeps the change unsaved with Retry.

**Office notes** (`Quote.internalNotes`). Shown and edited on the quote full page in Status and details as "Office notes (not shown to the client)", under the existing "Notes on the quote (the client sees these)"; on create (`createQuoteSchema.internalNotes`, at most 10,000 characters) and edit (PATCH `internalNotes`, empty clears it). Shown read-only in the Quotes pipeline side panel ("Office notes (not shown to the client)" or "None"). Every change is audited in the same transaction as the write: AuditLog `QUOTE_INTERNAL_NOTES_UPDATED`, entity Quote, actor, before and after text (an unchanged value or other edits write no row; a create with notes writes one). Not added to the pipeline search: the existing search does not cover notes. Never client-facing: the public quote payload (`buildPublicQuotePayload`, whitelisted) and the `/q/<token>` page props, the quote PDF and email body (`buildQuoteHtml` reads named fields), the send route (preview, body, subject and PDF attachments), the client documents mailer, the client portal My quotes route and Approvals / dashboard (`listQuotesWaiting`) use field lists without it; message template variables now drop it from the `quote` object (`{{quote.internalNotes}}` renders nothing; strict campaigns refuse it as unknown). The public respond and request-add-on routes answer fixed fields only. Admin reads (`GET /api/admin/quotes`, `GET/PATCH /api/admin/quotes/[id]`) return it.

**Tests.** `tests/api/quote-patch-stale-guard.test.ts` (match writes conditionally, mismatch 409 with the token and no write, lost race 409, unreadable token stale, no token = old update, public-link mint guarded, 404, office notes stored and audited before / after, clear, no audit when unchanged, 10,000-character limit), `tests/api/quote-internal-notes-client-surfaces.test.ts` (one per client-facing surface: public API payload, `/q` page props, PDF and email HTML, send preview and real send incl. attachments, documents mailer, My quotes, Approvals, message variables), `tests/components/quote-autosave.test.tsx` (debounce and "Saved N seconds ago", serialisation with the newest draft and new token, invalid field, conflict with Keep my edits and retry and with Reload theirs, failure not repeated until Retry, discount re-applied and its token adopted, the rules open only for Draft, no autosave on Sent / Accepted / Declined (Unsaved changes, Save changes sends the token) or converted (explicit Save with token) or new, status select not autosaved, Mark won after the save with that save's token, shared-quote note, leave warning only while unsaved), `tests/db/quote-autosave-internal-notes.test.ts` (PostgreSQL 55439: token match / stale / none with the row unchanged on 409, two concurrent saves on one version → one 200 and one 409 with one audit row, audit actor / before / after, office notes absent from the real public payload and Approvals rows). Changed on purpose: `tests/components/quote-full-page.test.tsx` (Mark won's PATCH body now carries `expectedUpdatedAt`).

**Verification.** Migration: fresh `quote_notes_fresh` deploy, repeat deploy nothing pending, `migrate diff` no difference; existing `sneek_ui` (0 quotes) deployed, repeated, no difference; seeded copy `quote_notes_seeded` (from a database at the previous migration, with two quotes) deployed with every other quote column identical before and after (checksum `ee8b7513…`), indexes unchanged. Not run here: production build, full suite, browser pass.

## Parity gaps restored: cleaner figures, notification group filter, role reference (2026-11-13)
